findings: P1 pillagers logo (x 800-1120, y 290-370): Make the wordmark flat. Use tx-1 #efe9dc at 56px f-cond 800 with no gradient and no shadow, or use flat --acc. Remove the shadow.

P1 mode buttons (y 441-665): Keep co-op as the only secondary row. Put the two arcade demos in a single 16px tx-2 row of two small buttons with a 16px gap, or move them into a submenu. Drop '(same machine)' or make it a 16px tx-2 sub-label.

P1 whole screen, empty space: Add one controlled art element. For example, a darkened key-art plate at 30 percent opacity behind the column, or a left-aligned layout with the menu in a 560px column at x 96 and hero art on the right. At the least, add a hairline --ui-line panel (--ui-panel, 4px radius, 24px padding) behind the column.

P2 saves block (y 685-805): Make the label 16px tx-2 at 4.5:1 or better. Use a --ui-raised fill with a 3px lime left bar for the selected save, and tx-1 for the name. Give the three bottom controls one fill, --ui-panel with a --ui-line-hi border. Put 32px between the mode list and the saves.
P2 tagline 'ascend. pillage. extract.' (y 406): Set it at 20px --tx-2 with +.04em tracking, with 16px between the logo and the tagline and 40px between the tagline and the buttons. Or delete it.

44-title-from-character-select.verdict: The title screen has a clear hierarchy, with a gold logo and a lime primary button, but it is crowded, a toast overlaps the key legend, and the logo's gold and the lime accent clash.
findings: P0 bottom centre, trophy toast over key legend: Move the toast to the top-centre or bottom-right, at least 24px clear of the legend, with an opaque --ui-panel fill. Alternatively, raise the legend 48px, or hide it while a toast shows.

P1 logo 'pillagers': Make the logo flat --tx-1 (#efe9dc) with no shadow, or flat lime. Let the 1 player button be the one saturated element. If the logo stays warm, use it only as the game's art mark and drop the lime elsewhere on the screen.

P1 menu column, 4 mode buttons: Show 1 player and 2 player co-op as the main pair. Move the arcade demos into a quiet tx-2 row or a sub-list at 16px. Cut '(same machine)' to '2 player'. Keep one lime button.

P1 saves block, y 700-825: Delete the stats line, since the save row already says '1 raid · $900'. Put 'change name' and 'create a new save' into a single secondary row with 16px gaps. Add 24px between the mode buttons and the saves label.

P1 fullscreen/settings buttons and save row: Use one idle-button spec: 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius, 16px/600 type, 40px minimum height. Reserve lime for the single focused element. Make the save row's selected state a 3px lime left bar with tx-1 text.

90-legend-full.verdict: The new version only adds a superhot toggle row to the key legend and trims a few lines of copy; the legend is still a big, dense, tiny-text wall that sits over the middle of the playfield and fights with every HUD element.
findings: undefined key legend (centre panel, 735-1170 x 155-927): Split it into a 2-column card sized to content, max ~60% height, with a 32px title ('controls') and a 48px X plus an esc/B hint. Cut it to the ~12 essential bindings. Use --ui-panel at 90% with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 24px padding.

undefined legend text size and contrast: Set rows to 20px (minimum 16px). Key chips in tx-1 with a --ui-raised fill and 1px --ui-line. Descriptions in tx-2 at ≥4.5:1. Section heads at 16px with +.04em tracking in --acc or tx-1, not amber (--warn is for warnings only). Raise the fill to --scrim .80+ so the map does not show through.

undefined legend column alignment and new last row: Render the backtick as a key chip like the others. Add 1px --ui-line dividers on a 48px row pitch. Keep 8px grid spacing between sections. Move 'f1 hide' into a 16px footer legend with a pad glyph.

undefined HUD colour and weight consistency (pillagers list, run info, concealed tag, codex toast): Map every accent to a token: lime --acc for focus only, --warn for warnings, --extract for extraction. Pull the label out from behind the minimap or clip it cleanly. Cap the HUD to the 5-size scale. Dim or hide the legend's backdrop competition.

undefined run info panel (right, 1585-1900 x 305-445): Use one panel style (same title colour and size for both panels). 16px padding on all sides. Give each objective row a 32px pitch with the count right-aligned in tx-2. Make the chevron ≥24px.

92-settings-superhot-pane.verdict: The new version drops the duplicated big 'off' from the detail pane and stretches the pane to full height, so it is cleaner and matches the list height, but the pane is now mostly empty and the settings list is still a long, flat, same-weight wall of rows.
findings: P1 detail pane (right, y 160-990): Either shrink the pane to fit its content (about 200px high, restore the 3px lime top bar), or use the space for a real preview or the value choices as a stacked list. Do not stretch an empty panel to 100% height.

P1 middle list, rows 'edit the words' to 'footsteps volume': Move the volume rows under the 'audio' tab. Where groups stay together, add a 16px tx-2 label per group with 24px space above. Show about 8 rows per screen at 56px, with the scroll hint made clearer.

P1 value column (x 730-990): Right-align the value group, or pull it to x about 600-860. Use tx-2 at 4.5:1 or more for idle arrows, and give 'open' a button-style chip to separate it from the toggle values.
P2 scrollbar (x 1050, y 118-310): Make the thumb 6px wide in --ui-line-hi with a 4px gap from the border, and add a bottom fade of 32px.

P2 left tab column: Keep one lime marker per column of focus: dim the selected tab to a tx-1 name with a 2px lime edge when focus is in the list, and use a 1px divider rather than a blank gap before 'send play data'.

60-mapfirst-1p.verdict: the map screen has gone from a blue-purple debug overlay to a proper dark centred card with a title bar, contracts list, footer and one lime main action, and the remaining faults are label collisions around the east blocks and uneven contract rows.
findings: P1 map, east blocks: 'extract b', 'stays open', 'chill row', 'cache' and the blast freezer icon cluster: Move 'extract b' and 'stays open' 24px right, into the empty strip beside the extract icon, and right-align them to that icon. Merge the crate rings into one 24px badge with a count. Move 'chill row' to the block's lower-left corner. Keep every label 8px from its own icon.

P1 contracts panel: progress bars and right column: Give every bar the same x-range, ending 16px before the right-aligned reward and count column. Use a #2e3337 track with a lime fill. Replace 'holding' with '0/1' or hide the bar on those rows. Keep green for 'done' only.

P2 map labels: 'hot ground', 'encampment' x2, 'extract a' and 'closes in 5:00': Set these labels to 16px/600 with a 2px #0b0c0d halo, or switch 'hot ground' to #efe9dc beside the 20px warn glyph. Lower the ring fill to about 12% alpha. Move 'extract a' and its sub-line 16px down and 12px left of the extract icon to clear the ring.

P2 map, zone names (packing floor, the long dock, the sump, scrap line): Set them at 16px/600 #aaa498 with +.04em tracking and a halo. Pin each to an empty top-left corner of its zone, 8px inside the border. Keep pickup labels #efe9dc.

P2 header: 'cold storage', 'sector map', 'dawn · clear', x: Align 'sector map' to the title's baseline with a 16px gap and set it to 20px #aaa498. Put 'dawn · clear' at 16px #aaa498 with a 24px gap to the x. Add a lime focus ring on the x when the pad is on it.

91-snip-panel-raid.verdict: The lime frame, size tag and copy/save actions are clearer than before, but the whole HUD is still at full strength, the controls cheat-sheet still collides with the frame, and the selection is still washed in blue, so it reads as a debug overlay rather than a polished snip mode.
findings: P1 controls cheat-sheet (492-902, 697-867): Hide the sheet while snip mode is active. If it must stay, move it at least 16px clear of the frame (top ≥ 735), use 16px #aaa498 text on a 24px row pitch, and add 16px padding so no row is clipped.

P1 whole HUD (pillagers board, run info, minimap, hotbar, hp/stamina, ammo block, toasts): Fade all HUD to 25% opacity while snipping. Keep only the frame, the size tag and the actions. Show one toast at most.
P1 selection interior (520-1239, 300-719): Remove the blue fill and show the inside at 100%. Dim the outside with --scrim (rgba(6,7,8,.80)). Add 8px square corner handles on the 2px lime border.

P1 copy / save action box (942-1239, 728-802): Drop the outer box and keep the two buttons only. Use 20px 700 labels, 56px high, 16px below the frame, right-aligned to it. Make save transparent with a 1px #4a5257 border. Add a 2px lime focus ring with a 2px offset.
P2 size tag '720 x 420 px' (520-630, 264-292): Use the panel component: --ui-panel fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius, 16px f-cond 600 text. Sit it flush on the frame's top-left edge. Use '×'.

20-raid-hud-drop.verdict: The only change is that the contract-item toast is gone, so the keybind legend no longer has a banner pressed against it; the HUD is still a set of mismatched dark boxes with a capital letter and a clipped fill.
findings: P0 top-left 'current pillagers' list and top-right 'run info' bar: Build every HUD panel on one component: fill --ui-panel at about 92% opacity, 1px --ui-line-hi border, --rad 4px, 16px padding, header in 16px f-cond 600 +.04em. Give the list, the run info bar, the legend and the ammo card the same border and header height of 32px.

P0 top-right, 'run info' header: Set one HUD margin of 24px (--sp-3) from every screen edge. Make the 'current pillagers' list and the run info bar the same 32px header height and align both text baselines to it.

P1 top-left list, the 'I' in 'run Info': Change the string to 'run info' (and check that no code uppercases it). Raise the list rows and header to 16px minimum and the money column to 16px f-cond 600.

P1 bottom-left, hp bar: Inset it to x=24 and y=1080-24-24. Make it a 24px-tall bar with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius, and put 'hp' in 16px label type with '100' at 20px inside it. Keep 56px --fs-hero for ammo only.

P1 bottom-left, two round status icons above hp: Draw them as 32px rectangles with 4px radius, a 1px border and a tinted fill, 8px apart. Put a 16px label under each ('hidden', 'luck') or show the label on focus.

34-raid-downed-pickups.verdict: The down card is a clear focal point with a big timer and a lime key hint, but the HUD around it is a pile of competing boxes in mixed styles and sizes, and the toast stack at bottom-left has a duplicate and an overlap.
findings: P1 toast stack, bottom-left (new version): Remove the duplicate from the toast stack. Keep the pill, or show it once with the same row component (3px bar, icon, 20px label, 8px gap). Stop world labels drawing under toast rows, or push the labels to 40% alpha behind a 16px offset.

P1 HUD panels, overall: Give every HUD panel the same fill (--ui-panel at 90%), a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Allow only one left-edge tab style, 3px, in lime for the main item or tx-2 for the rest. Remove the extra bar colours.

P1 top-right career and run info panels: Pending cw-trcol, set both panels to the same 24px padding and 8px row gap. Make the contract lines tx-1 at 16px with a lime progress count, and lift tx-2 to at least 4.5:1 on the panel fill.

P2 down card, centre: Remove the corner notch or make it a full 3px danger top tab, 36px wide. Colour the progress fill --danger. Set the title to 32px f-cond 700 and the timer to 56px 800, with a 16px gap between them.

P2 bottom-left down badge, stamina and hp bars: Align all three to the same left edge and width (430px). Give them the same 4px radius and fill treatment. Make the '-40' tx-1. Tone stamina down to tx-2 on a --ui-line track.

36-raid-low-health.verdict: The new frame is nearly identical to the old one. The only visible change is a duplicate 'running slowly' notice at lower left in place of the amber contract chip. The HUD is still cluttered with many same-weight boxes and a red-orange wash over the whole map, and the low-health state has no clear hero or focus.
findings: P0 top-right run info card, contract lines: Set the run info title at 16px tx-2 and the contract rows at 16px/600, with the 0/x counts right-aligned in a fixed column. Cut each row to 3-4 words, for example 'search 2 containers'. Give the card 16px padding with the right edge on the 5% margin.

P1 bottom-left notice stack ('running slowly' repeated): Show each status once. Remove the lower-left duplicate or the centre pill. Give every chip in the stack the same 3px left bar, 16px text and 8px gap, and use tx-2 for the neutral ones. Use --warn only for real warnings.

P1 whole-screen low-health tint: Cut the tint to a vignette: transparent in the centre 60%, ~25% --danger alpha only in the outer 20% of the screen. Give the hp bar a 56px/800 number and a solid --danger fill proportional to hp, plus a 2px pulse on the outline below 25 hp.

P1 controls card (centre bottom): Collapse it by default after the first 20 s and keep only the 'f1 full list' hint at 14px in the footer. If it stays open, set the text to 16px/600 tx-1 for keys and tx-2 for actions, and align it to the 5% left margin.

P1 top-left scoreboard and top-right career/run boxes: Raise row text to 16px with 8px row spacing. Dim the scoreboard rows (tx-2) and keep only 'you' in tx-1 with the lime bar. Merge the career box into one hero figure (backpack $2,170 at 20px/800).

51-arcade-alert-reinforcements.verdict: The new shot is cleaner in one respect: the red alert banner and the two threat rows are gone from the log. But the top-centre pill still duplicates the log's last row, and the score block, run info panel and vitals still have the problems I listed last time.
findings: P0 top-centre 'pillager reinforcements' pill and the bottom row of the left log: Make the live alert one 320x40 card with a 3px --warn left bar, 20px f-cond 600 tx-1 text, 16px padding, and 16px below the score block. Show the log only for events older than the live alert. Don't repeat the live event as a bright row.

P0 left event log (running slowly, stronghold, golden enemy, pillager reinforcements): Use a max of 3 rows, each a fixed 320x32 --ui-panel at 90% with a 3px left bar (--warn for info). Use 16px f-cond 600 text in tx-1 or tx-2, with an 8px gap between rows. Delete the icons and the '1 on the map' tail. Fade older rows by opacity only, to a floor of 60%.

P1 top-right 'run info' / 'run goals' panel: Drop 'run info' and the chevron. Make 'run goals' a 16px tx-2 label, then 20px tx-1 goal names with the reward right-aligned in tx-2. Use 16px padding, 1px --ui-line dividers, and a 24px margin from the screen edge. Give every goal an n/m count. Keep the dock cache label at least 24px inside the screen.

P1 top-centre score block (0 sp / 9:45 / extract 154m): Use one panel 16px from the top. Put the timer in 56px f-cond 800 tx-1, the score as a 20px line beneath it, and the 16px --extract line with the arrow attached to its left. Use one 4px radius and 16px padding.

P1 bottom-left vitals (standing, armour, stamina, hp): Draw three bars at 20px high with 8px gaps. Put the 16px label inside the left edge and the value on the right. Use --ok for hp, --extract for stamina and a neutral for armour. Make 'standing' a plain 16px tx-2 label with no box. Show the damage as a tx-1 number that fades out.

78-raid-pause-box-full-kit.verdict: A clean, calm column menu with one clear lime primary action and a red abandon, but it is a small box on a very dark screen, with no pad focus state shown and no run info.
findings: P1 whole card: Either make this one deliberate exception to the 90% rule and record it in the guide, or add one quiet context row under the title in tx-2 at 16px (for example raid time and $ carried). Dim the backdrop to --scrim .80 so the HUD ghost looks intentional.

P1 button stack: Keep the column for resume, settings and abandon. Fold the three rare items into one row of 16px text links in tx-2 under a 1px --ui-line divider, or make them one row of three equal ghost buttons at 40px height.

P1 abandon run: Make it a 56px outlined button with a --danger border and text, with the same 16px gap as the other rows. Equalise the card padding to 40px on all sides. Lift the red slightly, to about #f0583f, to clear 4.5:1.
P2 title row: Align the tab to the title's left edge (x=760) or drop it. Raise the divider to --ui-line-hi. Make the X hit area 44px with a hover or focus fill.
P2 resume run: Set the label to 22px 700. Add a 16px key hint on the right (for example the pad button glyph or esc) in --acc-ink so the live prompt is visible.

74-pad-call-of-duty.verdict: A tidy, consistent dark card with a clear lime focus on the layout selector, but the controller diagram is sloppy (overlapping labels), the type is small and dim, and the screen shows the same bindings three times.
findings: P1 controller diagram, d-pad cluster and d-right: Draw the d-pad as a 3x3 cross with 48px arms, one label per arm, all boxed the same. Put d-right in the right arm. Make every label 16px f-cond 600 with the same 1px --ui-line-hi box. Make the stick circles at least 64px so 'move' and 'ls' fit at 16px.

P1 whole screen: Drop the legend table under the diagram, or drop the left list. Keep the list as the rebind surface (it has the 'a rebind' action) and let the diagram highlight the focused row's button in lime. Give the freed space to a bigger diagram.

P1 left list rows and legend rows: Make row names 20px f-cond 600 in tx-1. Make the key chips 20px. Make section headers 16px tx-2 with +.04em tracking and a 1px divider above. Make the legend values 20px and the keys 16px tx-2, never dimmer than 4.5:1.

P1 footer hint 'a rebind b back': Use 16px with tx-1 and key chips: [a] rebind   [b] back, 24px apart, placed bottom-left or centred in the 72px footer row beside 'reset to defaults'. Show the live key or button of the device in use.

P2 title row and header: Make the X 32px with a 2px stroke inside a 48px hit area. Make the arrows and the name box the same 48px height. Make the 'layout' label 16px tx-2. Make the top tab a visible 36x2px lime bar over the title, or remove it.

74-pad-lefty.verdict: A clean, consistent dark card with a clear title, a visible lime focus box and a working close x, but the controller diagram has overlapping labels and the screen repeats every binding twice, so the eye has no single place to land.
findings: P0 controller diagram, d-pad cluster: Draw the d-pad as a 96px cross with the four labels in equal 28px pills set 12px outside each arm. Give d-right the same pill as the others. Nothing may touch the pad outline.

P1 controller diagram, left stick and thumbstick labels: Use one pill component at --rad 4px and 16px type for every label. Keep a minimum 16px gap between any two labels. Move the stick labels clear of the d-pad.

P1 hierarchy: whole body: Remove the legend table under the diagram, or make the diagram the only one with names. Give the diagram labels the action name plus the pad button. Let the list stay as the rebind control.

P1 left list, row type and key chips: Set section heads to 16px tx-2 at 4.5:1 or better with a 1px divider above. Show a 2px lime left bar and --ui-raised fill on the focused row. Make the scrollbar 8px, or paginate by section so no row is cut off.
P1 layout selector row: Make the arrows and name one 48px segmented control with equal heights. Use the lime border only on the focused part. Put the counter in tx-2 right-aligned, or drop it.

74-pad-pillagers.verdict: The pad buttons screen is now a clean full card with a lime focus on the layout selector, a controller diagram and a legend. The hierarchy is flat, the controller labels are cramped and overlap their outlines, and it duplicates the same information in three places.
findings: P1 controller diagram, d-pad and stick labels: Draw the d-pad as a 96px cross with four arm labels centred inside the arms at 16px, and give d-right its own arm. Use one label size (16px) for every pad label. Make the face buttons 40px circles with 16px letters. Keep the 'move' and 'aim' captions the same size as the other labels.

P1 whole screen, hierarchy: Make the controller outline stroke --ui-line-hi (#4a5257) and fill --ui-raised. Light the buttons in tx-1. Shrink the layout selector to a 48px high chip, with the name at 20px/700. Keep lime only on the focused element.

P1 left list vs right legend: Delete the legend table, or make it the only list. Label the diagram buttons directly with the action at 16px beside each button. Make the names identical between the two lists.
P1 legend text contrast: Use --tx-2 (#aaa498) at 16px minimum for keys and headers, --tx-1 for actions. Add 8px more space above each group header and a 1px --ui-line rule.

P2 footer hint 'a rebind b back': Render as two chips ('a' + 'rebind', 'b' + 'back') at 16px with 16px between them, on the same baseline as 'reset to defaults' (y=972). Use tx-2 for the words and tx-1 on a 24px key chip.

13-mainframe-rewards.verdict: The rewards screen is cleaner than before, with a visible focus row, a footer action and kind-coded edge bars. It is still a long flat table with no hero, no progress fill and no readable state, so it falls short of polished.
findings: P1 xp bar and the list below it: Give the bar a 12px height with a --acc fill and tier ticks. Put 'next reward in 7,200' in --fs-hero (56px, f-cond 800) beside it, or show the number as the hero and make the bar a thin 8px strip under it. Delete the 'xp' label or move it into the bar.

P1 rows 2, 5 and 7: coloured left edge bars: Use one meaning per colour. Either drop the bars, or colour them by rarity (--r-* at 3px) and put a 16px label for the kind in the row. Make the focus bar 4px --acc on the left edge and move the scrollbar thumb to --ui-line-hi.

P1 right-hand cost chips (7,200 etc.): Show one value: 'xp needed' as a single 18-20px f-cond number in tx-1 for the focused or next row and tx-2 for the rest. Delete the chip box or turn it into a state pill (claimable, locked) at 16px.

P1 claim all button, bottom right: Use a 56px-tall button. Disabled state: fill --ui-raised, text tx-2, 1px --ui-line-hi border. Enabled state: --acc fill with --acc-ink text. Add a 16px reason, 'next at 7,200 xp', next to it.

P2 toast at top, 'the welcome pack is in your stash.': Shorten it to 'welcome pack in stash' and drop the full stop. Position it at y=48 (safe margin), or show it only on the first open and not on tab entry.

15-mainframe-stats.verdict: it is a clean, consistent dark card with a proper x, tabs and one lime hero, but the body is a flat grid of identical boxes with empty cells, an explaining paragraph, a 'locked' prefix repeated on every row and a clipped last row, so it reads as a template and not a polished AAA stats screen.
findings: P1 notoriety card: cut to the state word 'clean' plus at most a 3-5 word tag (e.g. 'no bounty'). Move the rule into a hover or focus tooltip. Set the card to the same 16px label style as the other two.

P1 stats row: experience / notoriety / net lifetime earnings: make three equal columns (about 1/3 each, 16px gutters) and height 160px instead of 270. Put every value on one baseline at y=card top+96. Give 'net lifetime earnings' a hero-weight or matching 32px number in tx-1. Add a thin progress bar under 'level 1' using a lime 4px fill.

P1 achievements grid: drop the 'locked' word. Show locked state by dimming the name to tx-2 at 60% plus a 16px padlock glyph at the right. Unlocked tiles get a 3px lime left bar and tx-1 name. Add a 40px icon square at the left (x=136) and a small progress fraction such as '0/1' in 16px tx-2 at the right.

P1 bottom of the scroll area (y~975-1003): add 24px bottom padding to the scroll container and a 32px fade-to-panel gradient at the clip edge. Make the clip end at the card's inner padding (y=1000), not mid-row. Inset the scrollbar 8px from the tiles (tile right edge 1778, scrollbar at 1792).

P1 header resource strip (top right): use one pattern: 20px tx-1 number plus 16px tx-2 label, with even 24px gaps, e.g. '$900', '0 xp', '$3,750 stash', '$0 bag'. Put the x button 24px to the right, 48px square.

74-pad-player-1.verdict: A clean, centred column menu with a clear lime primary action and a strong wordmark. The wordmark's orange gradient, the weak secondary type and the cluttered footer keep it from reading as polished.
findings: P1 title wordmark 'pillagers': Fill the wordmark flat --tx-1 (#efe9dc), or flat lime, at 800 weight. Remove the gradient and shadow. Leave the lime fill for '1 player' alone.

P1 menu column, 5 mode buttons: Drop the 'coming later' row (or move it below saves as a 14px footnote). Shorten the labels to '2 player co-op' and 'arcade demo', and move the parentheses to a 16px --tx-2 sub-label. Put a 24px gap between the play group and the demo group. The disabled row needs at least 4.5:1.

P1 saves block: Make the 'saves' label 16px --tx-1 at 70 percent with +.04em tracking. Use --ui-raised with a 3px lime left bar for the selected row, not a full lime outline. Give the controls row the same 48px height as the rows above, and the input a 1px --ui-line-hi border with an explicit placeholder style.
P2 footer key legend: Show the live pad prompt (a / move, b / back) when a pad is the active device. Raise key caps and labels to 16px, and set labels in --tx-2 at at least 4.5:1.

P2 top-right buttons 'go fullscreen' / 'settings': Use the idle button border --ui-line-hi, the same 4px radius and a 48px height to match the menu rows. Add them to the pad focus order, or hide 'go fullscreen' on pad.

74-pad-player-2.verdict: The title screen has a clear hierarchy, with a gradient logo and one lime call to action. The small text, the save block and the amber logo that clashes with the lime accent keep it from reading as polished.
findings: P1 title logo 'pillagers': Make the logo flat --tx-1 (#efe9dc) with no gradient and no glow, at about 96px weight 800. Let the lime button be the one hot element. If the logo keeps colour, use one flat tone that is clearly not near the lime.

P1 saves block: 'saves' label, save row, name input and buttons: Use one 56px row of the --ui-raised panel for the selected save. Put 'change name' and 'create a new save' as quiet text buttons on one 40px row, 16px below, aligned to the same 558px edges. Give the input a --ui-raised fill with a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Use a 16px label with 16px of space below it.

P1 small text: 'player 2 window', tagline, 'saves' label, version: Set 'player 2 window' and 'saves' to 16px --tx-2 (#aaa498). Set the tagline to 20px --tx-1 at 80% opacity. Put the version stamp at 14px, aligned to the 5% margin (96px), with the same baseline as the key legend.

P1 top-left 'keyboard' badge and top-right 'go fullscreen' and 'settings': Inset all three corner items to a 48px margin. Give the badge the standard --ui-line-hi border and tx-2 text, with a 16px label. Make 'go fullscreen' and 'settings' quiet (--ui-line border, tx-2 text) until focused. On this screen the teal is the extract colour and should not be used for the badge.
P2 key legend at bottom: Cut the legend to 'f1 controls' only, since the full list lives on the controls screen. If it stays, use a muted --ui-line-hi cap outline and tx-2 text, and 16px labels.

41-hub-backpack-pad-p1.verdict: A clean, consistent dark card with a clear lime focus tile, but the equipped strip and the detail pane are weak, the type is too small and dim, and the idle grid is a field of identical empty boxes.
findings: P1 detail pane (right): Show the hero stat (dmg 23) at 56px f-cond 800. Put the rarity as a 3px bar on the left edge or at the top of the pane. Set the rarity tag at 16px in --r-rare. Move 'in backpack' to the bottom as a 16px tx-2 label, or drop it. Shrink the pane height to fit its content, or fill it with a compare bar per stat.

P1 equipped strip (top left): Left-align the label at x=121 plus 24px padding, the same as the section labels. Put the icon, the name at 20px tx-1, and the stats at 16px in a single row with 24px gaps. Reduce the strip height from 128px to about 96px, or place the stats in a spaced row so the strip does not read as empty.

P1 tactical belt slots 4, 6, 7, 8, 0: Raise the empty ghost opacity to about 25%. Set slot numbers to 16px --tx-2 or brighter. Use one focus language: if amber is the player ring, show it only as a 2px outline and keep the lime for the active selection. Alternatively, add a small 'equipped' tick to slot 1 instead of an orange fill.

P1 backpack grid (3x8 cells): Use --ui-line at 40% on idle cells with a 1px inner top highlight, and a subtle cell-index tick pattern. Alternatively, shrink the grid to the actual capacity (backpack 2 shows 2 of 24). Make the rarity bar 3px, consistent with the guide.
P2 footer legend: Draw 'b' in a chip like the others, with lime only on the chip border. Raise the scrim to .80 and make the card 92% tall so the world hint strip does not show beneath it.

41-hub-backpack-pad-p2-held.verdict: A clean, consistent dark card with a clear lime focus on the belt slot, but the 24-slot grid is mostly empty, and the type is small and low-contrast. The equipped strip and the detail pane share one visual weight, and the gaps don't follow the 8px grid.
findings: P1 detail pane (right): Colour the 'rare' tag --r-rare as a 16px chip. Move the 3px rarity bar to the top or left edge. Anchor the stats block to the pane's vertical centre or add a compare row. Reconcile 'held' with 'equipped' so they don't contradict, for example by showing 'held in slot 5'.

P1 equipped strip and backpack grid: Cut the strip to 72px, one row: icon left, name 20px, stats inline in tx-2 16px. Left-align 'equipped' at x=121 like the other section labels. Raise 'melee' to 16px.

P1 tactical belt: Use exactly one lime focus ring, 3px. Mark the equipped slot with a 3px accent bar, not an amber fill. Put the numbers in tx-2 at 16px with a 4.5:1 floor. Drop the blue fill on slot 3 or tie it to rarity only.
P2 backpack grid: Rename it 'backpack 2/24'. Dim the empty slots to --ui-line fill at 50%. Raise the rarity bar to 3px. Consider a smaller grid or a weight readout so the card doesn't look empty.
P2 footer legend: Use real a/b/x/y face-button glyphs coloured to the pad, and 18px chips. Keep a single close affordance: the 'b close' footer plus the x. Make the legend tx-1 at 16px.

30-settings-scroll-2400.verdict: A clean, consistent dark card with a clear lime focus row and an x in the corner, but the detail pane is mostly empty and uses an explaining sentence, and several small craft errors (clipped last row, uneven row gaps, tiny type) keep it from looking finished.
findings: P1 right detail pane: Remove the sentence or shorten it to 3 to 5 words directly under the 32px title (8px gap). Use the pane for a value preview or a default-versus-current readout, or shrink the pane and give the list the width. Set any kept text in tx-2 at 20px, never dimmer than 4.5:1.

P1 settings list, bottom rows ('kid firing', 'player 2 takes less damage'): Snap every row to one 56px pitch. Add a 24px gradient fade or a 56px bottom inset where the list clips. Make the scrollbar 8px wide in --ui-line-hi with a lime thumb when focused. Give the arrow-less rows the same chevron pair, or right-align their values to the same x as the other rows.

P1 left category column: Use one focus pattern: a 4px lime left bar plus a --ui-raised fill on the active category, and a dimmer variant (bar in --ui-line-hi) when focus is in the list. Put a 1px --ui-line divider above 'send play data'. Set category text to 20px, tx-1 when active and tx-2 otherwise.

P1 row value controls (the chevron-value-chevron triplets): Make the chevrons 20px with a 48px hit area. Cut the gap by moving the control cluster to a fixed 280px block that is right-aligned. Show unfocused chevrons in tx-2 and focused ones in lime. Add a subtle pill behind the value on the focused row.

P2 outer card and title area: Make the accent tab a deliberate 3px by 36px lime bar flush to the card's top edge and aligned with the title's left edge (x=48). Set the title to 32px and vertically centre it in a 56px header. Merge the close hint into the X ('x  esc') or place it as a 14px key-hint in the footer with the pad glyph.

30-settings-daily-restore.verdict: The restore row now fits and the lime restore button is the clear primary action, but the detail pane is sparse and the scroll position, the key chips and the row rhythm are untidy.
findings: P1 right detail pane: Show the date in the 56px hero style (800 weight, tx-1) with 'saved' as a 16px tx-2 label above it. Drop the duplicate 'yesterday' and the 'undo last restore' line. Either add a real consequence line such as 'replaces current progress' in 16px --warn, or shrink the pane to fit its content.

P1 restore from a backup row (focused): Keep the row at a single height with the label at left and the controls at right, like 'back up your progress'. Use lime fill only for the focused control. Give 'restore' a --danger outline or a confirm step, and make 'undo' a ghost button. Match all three controls to one 44px height and 4px radius.

P1 settings list, column x=354..1040: Use one row height of 56px. Give every toggle the same chevron control. Give actions an outlined button look. Use group dividers of 24px only between sections, and add small group labels at 16px tx-2 if the groups are needed.

P2 left tab list: Set all tabs to 56px rows. Make the selected tab a --ui-raised fill with a 3px lime bar and tx-1 text. Remove the stray tick on the card frame, or use it as the panel's accent tab on the detail pane.
P2 scroll area, right edge x=1050: Use a 6px scrollbar thumb in --ui-line-hi, show it only when the list scrolls, and remove the bottom fade where there is nothing below.

74-pad-arc-raiders.verdict: A clean, consistent dark card with a clear lime focus on the layout selector, but the controller diagram is crowded with overlapping labels and the type is small and inconsistent.
findings: P1 controller diagram, d-pad area: Draw the d-pad as a real 3x3 cross about 120px wide. Put each label inside its arm at 16px with 8px padding, or place all four labels outside on leader lines. Never let text overlap an outline.

P1 controller diagram, overall: Use one chip style (4px radius, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 16px f-cond 600 label) for every callout. Raise the body outline to --ui-line-hi. Make the face buttons 40px circles. Add a lime tint to the control currently focused in the list.

P1 left rebind list vs right legend table: Delete the legend table. Let the diagram carry the overview and the list carry the rebinding. Or keep only the legend and drop the callouts. This also frees about 340px of height for a larger diagram.

P1 left list, scrollbar and row design: Show a focus row fill (--ui-raised with a 3px lime left bar) for the selected row. Make section headers 16px, 700 weight and 0.08em tracking, with a 1px divider above. Make the key chips 96x44 with 20px text. Add a fade or count ('9/24') at the bottom so the list reads as scrollable.
P2 layout selector row: Make the selector 320px wide with 24px text. Move '4 / 6' under or inside the box as 16px tx-2. Align the row left edge to the 48px margin used by the title.

74-pad-fortnite.verdict: A clean, consistent card with a clear selector, but the controller diagram is badly crowded and overlapping, and the page has no real hero, so a couch player won't find the layout at a glance.
findings: P0 controller diagram, d-pad cluster (d-up/d-left/d-down/d-right): Redraw the d-pad as a 96px cross. Put the four labels in 16px chips outside each arm with 8px clearance, or put a single glyph inside each arm. Draw d-right level with d-left, not above it.

P1 controller diagram, stick bubbles and shoulders: Use one label size (16px f-cond 600) inside the bubbles. Space the chip rows 8px apart. Raise the body stroke to --ui-line-hi (#4a5257) at 2px. Highlight the selected layout's key buttons with lime.
P1 hierarchy, whole card: Make the layout name the hero at 40-56px f-cond 800 between the arrows. Keep the lime focus border but add a filled --ui-raised background. Dim the rest to tx-2.

P1 bottom-right legend 'a rebind b back': Raise to 16px tx-1. Give each button a round or square key chip (a, b) followed by its verb, with 24px between pairs: [a] rebind  [b] back. Align the baseline with the 'reset to defaults' button.

P1 readout table below the diagram vs the left binding list: Drop the lower table and let the diagram carry the key-to-action mapping through callouts, or keep the table but render keys as tx-1 chips and actions in tx-2. Never show both.

74-pad-top-down.verdict: A clean, near-full-screen card with a clear focus ring on the layout selector, but the controller diagram is sloppy, the type is small and the footer is weak, so a couch player would not call it polished yet.
findings: P1 controller diagram (d-pad and d-right label): Draw the d-pad cross as a 96px plus with the four labels centred in their arms at 16px, each at least 8px from the outline. Put d-right inside the right arm. Use one tag style (4px radius, 1px --ui-line-hi) for every callout. Move the sticks 16px inward from the shell edge.

P1 mapping legend at the bottom right (lt/rt list) and the left action list: Drop the bottom legend and give that space to a larger diagram (scale it about 1.3x). Or keep the legend and drop the diagram labels. If it stays, raise the button column to --tx-1 and 18px.

P1 footer hint 'a rebind b back': Render each as a 24px round chip containing the letter, followed by a 16px --tx-1 label ('rebind', 'back') with 24px between the pairs. Align the right edge to the 48px margin.

P1 left binding list: Make headers 16px, +.08em tracking, --tx-2, with a 1px --ui-line rule above and 16px more space. Show a focused row with a --ui-raised fill and a 3px --acc left bar. Snap the scroll so no row is cut off, and widen the scrollbar to 8px.

P2 layout selector row (layout / arrows / 5 / 6): Make the arrows 56px squares with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 20px glyph. Put the counter at 16px --tx-2 right after the arrows with 16px of gap. Centre the label on the 56px row line.

79-experimental-top.verdict: A clean dark card with a clear focus row, but it is a 28-row list of identical 'on' chips with no state contrast, a mostly empty detail pane, a spacing glitch, and tiny fine print, so it reads as a debug panel rather than a polished settings screen.
findings: P1 image 1, list between 'air strike' and 'golden enemy': Always draw the group headers, or remove the gap when headers are off. Use one header row of 32px at 16px tx-2 and a consistent 56px row pitch.

P1 toggle column, all rows: Draw on as an --acc-ink-on-lime 56x32 chip or a lime switch, and off as an outlined --tx-2 chip. Move the chips to the right edge with 24px padding, or make the whole row the toggle.

P1 right detail pane: Remove the duplicate chip. Use the pane for a short label such as 'starts next raid' at 20px tx-1, and shrink the pane, or give the list the extra width. Put the state in the title row as a lime word.

P1 focused row control (run goals): Keep one focus signal: the 3px lime bar plus the raised fill. Show the chevrons in plain lime with no frame, and delete the white bar. Keep the frame within the 56px row height.
P2 footer legend, bottom right: Set it at 16px minimum, tx-2 at 4.5:1, with 24px gaps between the pairs. Show the key or pad glyphs for the active device.

28-settings-scroll-1200.verdict: A clean, consistent dark settings card with lime focus on the sprint row, but the list is a long scroll in which the controls, controller and display options all run together. The detail pane is mostly empty, and the sidebar's active tab is only lightly marked.
findings: P1 controls list, rows from 'pad buttons' down to 'effects': Move controller and display rows under their own tabs. If they stay in one list, add 16px f-cond section labels in tx-2 with 24px spacing above each group, and make the scrollbar thumb 6px wide in --ui-line-hi.

P1 right detail pane: Cut the pane to a compact card of about 240px height, or pin the description 16px under the title. Shorten the text to a few words per option, set it in 20px --tx-1 or at least 18px --tx-2 at 4.5:1 or better, and use the empty space for a small value list or a default/reset line.

P1 setting rows, left label vs value column: Right-align each value group to the row edge, or tighten the value column to about 220px. Raise the row divider to --ui-line at 1px full width, enlarge the chevrons to 20px, and set row text to 20px f-cond 600 (tx-1 for labels, tx-2 for idle values) so lime is used only on the focused row.

P2 left sidebar tabs: Fill the selected tab with --ui-raised, give it a 4px lime left bar, and set its text to tx-1 800. Set idle tabs to tx-2 600. Keep row spacing even at 64px, and put 'send play data' in a footer of the sidebar with a 1px divider if it must be separated.

P2 window frame: header, divider, footer: Set the title to 32px f-cond 700. Give the X a 40px hit area with a --ui-line-hi border on focus. Remove the lime tick, or turn it into a deliberate 36px by 2px top tab on the panel as the guide describes. Raise the esc hint to 16px --tx-2 and show the pad button when a pad is in use.

80-experimental-middle.verdict: The layout is clean and lower case, but the focused row has a double focus frame, the 'back' button scrolls with the list, and the detail pane is mostly empty, so it still looks like a template settings list.
findings: P1 left list, top: Pin the back/count header outside the scroll region, 56px tall, with a 1px --ui-line divider. Clip rows to start below it, or add a 16px fade at the scroll edge.

P1 orbital debris row, focused: Use one focus treatment: a 3px lime left bar, a --ui-raised row fill, and a lime 1px outline on the value chip only. Draw the chevrons in --tx-2, 20px, 8px from the chip. Remove the white bracket and the outer 2px rounded frame.

P1 right detail pane: Drop the duplicate chip. Show a 56px hero state ('off' in lime or --tx-2), and put the 'starts next raid' note in the footer at 16px. Or narrow the pane to about 480px and give the list the rest of the width.

P1 row value chips, x≈940: Right-align the chips at 24px padding from the row edge, with a fixed 64px width. Draw 'on' quiet in --tx-2 with no border, and give 'off' a --warn outline, so the exceptions are the ones that read.

P2 list row spacing: Add 16px --tx-2 group labels ('field', 'threats', 'quality of life') with a 1px divider, or remove the gaps. Set a uniform 56px row height and vertically centre the chip and name.

29-settings-scroll-1800.verdict: The focused row now sits with context above it and the detail pane is tighter, but the settings screen is still one flat list of identical rows, and the clipped top row and unlabelled gap leave it short of polished.
findings: P1 settings list top edge: Clip the scroll area on whole rows, or add a 24px fade mask at the top and bottom. Align the scroll offset to the 56px row pitch so the top row is never sliced.
P1 list between 'vibration strength' and 'render resolution': Put a 16px label such as 'graphics' (tx-2, +.04em) in the gap, or move the graphics settings to the display tab. Cut the gap to 24px.
P1 detail pane, right side: Narrow the pane to about 30% of the card, or fill it with the current value, its default and a small preview. Keep the description short, at most 8 words.
P2 row hierarchy: Make labels tx-2 at weight 600 and values tx-1 at weight 800. Add 16px group headers every 5 to 6 rows.
P2 focused row: Extend the focus fill to the full list width. Make the scrollbar 6px wide in --ui-line-hi, or show a scroll-position count.

81-experimental-bottom.verdict: A functional dark settings list with correct lower case and a clear lime focus row, but the scrolled state has a clipped group header behind the back button, uneven row gaps, a nearly empty detail pane and tiny low-contrast text, so it reads as a template list and not a polished AAA menu.
findings: P0 top of left list, behind the back button: Put the back bar in a fixed 56px row above the scroll area with 16px padding. Clip the scroll region below it (top 183px) with a 12px fade mask so no half glyphs show. Or scroll the group header into view with its rows.

P1 detail pane (right, x1088-1870): Set the pane to a 24px-padded layout: title 32px, one description line 20px tx-1, status tag 16px tx-2 in the pane footer. Replace the redundant 'on' chip with a real toggle that matches the row control. Or shrink the pane to content height and give the list more width.

P1 left list row spacing: Give each group a visible 16px tx-2 label in a 40px header row, and use an exact 56px row pitch everywhere else. Move '28 features' into the screen header right of the title, or drop it.

P1 value chips and focused row: Show only deviations: a default 'on' becomes plain tx-2 text with no box. Draw the chip only on focus. Make the arrows 20px with a 16px gap, and right-align every value to x=1008 (24px inner padding).
P1 footer hint and fine text: Raise the hint to 16px with tx-1 key names and tx-2 labels, separated by 24px gaps. Raise 'starts next raid' to 16px at at least 4.5:1.

82-experimental-host.verdict: The layout is clean and readable, but the list scrolls with a stray header, the focus stepper is heavy and misaligned, and the right pane is mostly empty.
findings: P0 list top, 'back' row and scroll clip: Delete the in-list back button, since the x and esc already close. Pin the '28 features' count in a fixed 48px sub-header and clip the scroll region cleanly below it with no partial rows.

P0 focused row 'needed-item glow': Keep the 3px lime left bar and the --ui-raised row fill. Keep the toggle at its idle size and only change its border to lime. Drop the glow and the outer box. Show the arrows ‹ › at 16px tx-2 inside the same 32px pill, with no bracket.

P1 right detail pane: Remove the duplicate 'on' button, or turn it into a read-only status word. Set the description at 20px tx-1. Set the two status lines at 16px tx-2 with a 16px gap. Keep the lime top tab to 36px wide, not full width.

P1 toggle column x~915-970 and row alignment: Right-align the pills at 24px from the list edge. Make 'off' states dim and 'on' states lime-ink on a filled pill so state scans. Give every row an exact 56px, and add a 16px label for any group break instead of a blank gap.
P1 type sizes: Set row names to 20px f-cond 600. Set every read-aloud line to a minimum of 16px in --tx-2 (#aaa498) and keep 14px for the version stamp only.

31-settings-send-play-data.verdict: The screen is clean, readable and consistent, with the lime copy button as a clear primary action. It still looks like a form dropped into a big empty card, with weak hierarchy, a left-heavy header and nothing that says this game.
findings: P1 content column vs card: Align the content column's left edge to the title's 48px margin, or keep it centred and move the tab row to match it. Cap the card at about 1200px wide for this tab, or add a real status block (last send time, run count) to fill the height.

P1 headline '0 runs, 0 notes ready to send': Make the counts the hero. Show the numbers at 56px f-cond 800 in tx-1 and the labels at 16px tx-2. When both are 0, dim the line to tx-2 and disable 'copy to clipboard' and 'show data' (dimmed fill, no lime).

P1 copy to clipboard / show data / clear recorder row: Keep the safe actions together on the left, set the gap between buttons to 16px, and put 'clear recorder' at the right end of the same row, matching the card edge (it already does). Alternatively, move it into a separate danger zone under the restore panel, with the panel's border-top line as a divider.

P1 restore a character panel: Cut the sentence down to a short warning tag, 'replaces your save', in --warn at 16px f-cond 600 beside the title. Make the panel title 20px tx-1. Use the --ui-raised fill with 24px padding so it reads as a panel rather than another button.

P2 input field 'pil1...' and 'read code' button: Set the placeholder to --tx-2 (#aaa498). Put 'read code' to the right of the field at 56px height to match the 56px input. Give the focused input a 2px --acc border.

83-experimental-guest.verdict: A clean, consistent dark card with a clear lime focus row, but it is a flat list of 28 identical rows, the detail pane is mostly empty, and the focus control and sticky header are clumsy.
findings: P1 left list, focus row 'needed-item glow': Keep one signal: the 3px lime left bar plus a --ui-raised row fill. Draw the value as one 1px lime-bordered pill (height 32) with 16px chevrons inside it. Remove the outer glow and the bracket.

P1 right detail pane: Remove the duplicate 'on' pill. Show the description at 20px tx-1, then a 16px label/value pair block ('applies  next raid', 'this raid  off') in tx-2 at 4.5:1 or better. Anchor the block to the top and cut the pane height, or fill it with a short state summary.

P1 left list, top edge: Put the back and the '28 features' count in a fixed 56px header band outside the scroll area, with a clean 1px divider. Or drop 'back' entirely, since the X and the esc legend already cover it. Clip the scroll region below the header.
P2 list rows: Use a fixed 56px row pitch. Add 16px tx-2 group headers (e.g. 'raid', 'machines') with 24px above them where groups change. Remove the stray gaps.

P2 toggle pills, right-aligned at x≈940: Right-align the pills 24px from the panel edge. Style on as lime text with a 1px lime border and off as tx-2 on a --ui-line border, so state reads at a glance.

39-hub-after-raid.verdict: The new floor is clearly calmer and better organised: the labels are quiet 20px chips, one lime 'enter raid!' is the hero, the title sits in a panel and the key hints are chips. It still has loose ends: the stash and last-pour prompts are crowded, the career HUD is a small mismatched strip, and there is a stray amber warning line.
findings: P1 top-right career strip ('$900 130 xp stash $960 bag $0'): Put it in one --ui-panel card, 24px from the screen edge, with a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Use 20px for the values and 16px for the labels. Show 'sp' only if it is a score. Align it with the title card's top edge at y=48. The pending cw-trcol vertical list will replace it.

P1 '***experimental feature may glitch***' under 'the last pour': Delete it, or replace it with a 16px 'beta' tag in tx-2 inside the label chip. Drop the asterisks. Leave 8px between the chip and the ring.

P1 'enter raid!' label: Use --fs-title 32px f-cond 800 in a lime-bordered chip (2px --acc border, --ui-panel fill, 4px radius, 16px padding). Remove the '!'. Keep the lime fill only on the focus bar. Centre the chip on the station's x, 16px above the sprite.

P2 station labels (gambler, mainframe, shop, settings, stash, fashion, last pour): Use one 20px f-cond 600 label with 12px/8px padding, placed 12px above each station's top edge. Use a --ui-panel fill at 90% so the glow does not wash it out. Move the trophy toast clear of the stash chip.

P2 bottom centre: trophy toast and key-hint chips: Move the toast up to y≈120, centred under the title card, and give it a 3px --acc left tab. Keep the key-hint strip as the only bottom element at 16px. Use the same 4px radius, 1px --ui-line-hi border and 12px padding on both.

41-hub-backpack.verdict: It is a clean, consistent dark card with a clear lime focus tile and a big ammo number, but the right detail pane is mostly empty, the equipped strip and its labels are cramped, and the type sizes drift off the five-size scale.
findings: P1 detail pane (right, x1360-1798, y150-762): Shrink the pane to its content, or fill it. Make the item name 32px f-cond 700 at the pane top with the rarity bar directly under it. Set 'use: armor' as a label (16px, tx-2) on the left and its value (20px, tx-1) 16px away on the same baseline. Move the '$340 each' price to the pane's bottom edge as a footer, or drop it.

P1 equipped strip (y150-278) and 'backpack 6' label (y294): Align every label to x121. Raise the strip padding to 16px. Put the weapon name at 20px f-cond 700 in tx-1. Set the stats at 16px tx-2, in two columns separated by 24px gaps. Add 24px between the strip bottom and the 'backpack' label.

P1 tactical belt row (y810-937): Use one selected state on the belt: a 2px lime border and nothing else. Mark filled slots with a --ui-raised fill, and show empty slots as bare dark tiles with no silhouette, or at about 15% opacity. Raise the hotkey numbers to 16px tx-2. Make the amber on slot 1 a rarity bar or a warn glyph only.

P2 item tiles and stack badges (grid): Replace the pips with real quantity text, e.g. 'x2', at 16px f-cond 600 tx-1, set bottom-right on a --ui-void 70% chip. Scale the item art to about 70% of the tile and make the rarity bar 3px.

P2 type scale across the card: Snap every size to the 56/32/20/16/14 scale. Set the ammo as 56px for the loaded count and the reserve at 32px tx-2 (danger red at 0). Make the pane item name 32px. Set the footer legend at 14-16px, with only 'esc' in lime and 'close' in tx-2.

43-stash-after-raid.verdict: A competent dark inventory card with a good lime take button and a clean x, but it is overloaded: three data zones plus a legend share one screen, the type is tiny and uniform, and the stash grid is mostly empty while the right column is crammed.
findings: P1 right column, gun keys and item wheel (y 640-890): Give gun keys and item wheel their own tab or sub-pane, or shrink the empty backpack from 2 rows to 1 and give the freed 120px to the binds. Use 20px labels, 8px gaps and one reset per group in the header row.

P1 hierarchy, whole card: Make the title the quiet part and $900 the one hero number at 56px, or make the grid the star. Shrink 'take' to a 40px high button and keep it lime only when there is something to take. Fill or collapse the empty grid area.

P1 top-right header: '$900  130 xp  stash $960 bag $0': Keep one money figure ($900) and one xp figure, both at 20px, with 16px tx-2 labels. Move 'stash $960 bag $0' to the stash and loadout pane headers, where '$0 going up' already lives. Leave a 24px gap before the x.

P1 tab row (all 8, guns 2, ... trophies 2/8): Dim zero-count tabs to tx-2 at 50 percent or hide them. Make the selected tab a 3px lime underline with tx-1 text. Move armory and trophies to the header next to the x or into a separate right-aligned group with a 1px divider.
P2 stash item grid: Use a flat --ui-panel tile fill, a 3px rarity bar at the bottom, and a 16px count in a dark chip. Make the key badge a neutral outlined chip, reserving lime for the focused tile.

67-career-stash-stocked.verdict: This is a competent Diablo-style dark inventory card with a clear lime 'take' CTA and good rarity bars, but it is crowded and the type scale is inconsistent. The loadout pane is mostly empty while the footer is dense, and the 'take' bar competes with the header for attention.
findings: P1 header, top right: Keep one hero figure ($48,250 at 32px f-cond 800). Move 'xp' to tx-2 at 16px. Delete 'stash $8,405 bag $0' and keep only '$0 going up' in the loadout pane.

P1 bottom, 'freebie kit' / 'take' row: Fold it into the card footer. Make it a 56px footer row with the label left and a 160x40 'take' button directly after the label (24px gap), or move it into the loadout pane. Keep one filled button per card.

P1 footer: key legend, 'sell all salvage' bar, 'freebie kit' row: Merge them into one 72px footer. Put the legend on the left in 14px tx-2 and 'sell all salvage $1,975' as a real outlined button (40px high, 20px text) on the right. Drop the second bar.

P1 loadout pane (backpack, tactical belt, gun keys, item wheel): Enlarge gun key and item wheel icons to at least 32px. Raise the numerals to 16px tx-2. Give empty slots a 1px --ui-line border and an 8px gap so they read as slots. Add a short empty-state label in the backpack, such as 'drop items here'.

P2 type scale across the card: Snap to the five sizes. Section labels at 20px f-cond 600 tx-1 with a 1px --ui-line divider under them. Sub-section labels at 16px tx-2. Counts and badges at a minimum of 16px, or drop them.

68-settings-sec-the-raid.verdict: It is a clean, consistent card with a clear lime focus bar. But the detail pane is a large empty box with a paragraph at the bottom, the list is crowded and has no section headers, and two cell states look the same, so it is not yet polished.
findings: P1 right detail pane: Anchor the title and body together at the top with a 16px gap. Cut the body to one short line of 20 words or fewer at fs-body 20px in tx-1. Or show the current value and a default marker, and drop the prose.

P1 centre list, rows after 'experimental': Move the volume rows to the audio tab. If they stay, add a 16px tx-2 section label row ('audio') with a 1px --ui-line divider and 24px extra spacing. Make the scrollbar 6px wide in --ui-line-hi. Add a row-fade or a 'more' cue at the bottom.

P1 value column, chevrons and 'experimental' row: Show the chevrons only on the focused or hovered row. Give 'experimental' a single right-aligned chevron or a boxed 'open' pill in --ui-line-hi so it reads as a different control.

P2 left tab column: Use one focus recipe everywhere: a 3px lime left bar on a --ui-raised fill, with no outline box. Raise idle tab text to tx-1 at 20px, or at least tx-2 at 18px. Put a 1px divider above 'send play data' or move it to 'saves and tools'.

P2 title row and top edge: Set the title to 32px f-cond 700. Either make the tick a deliberate 36px by 2px top tab on the left edge with a 4px inset, or delete it. Make the X 36px with a 2px stroke in tx-1 and a visible hover and focus state.

69-settings-sec-audio.verdict: A clean, consistent dark card with a clear lime focus, but the audio tab shows a list that runs on into controls and gameplay rows, and the detail pane is mostly empty.
findings: P1 center list, below 'music': Show only audio rows under 'audio' (8 to 9 rows). Move keys and aim settings to 'controls'. If sections must share a tab, add a 16px f-cond tx-2 section label with a 1px --ui-line divider and 24px space above it.

P1 left tab column: Use one focus language. Tab: 3px lime left bar, --ui-raised fill, tx-1 text, no outline. Row: the same. When focus is in the list, keep the tab at tx-1 with the bar and no outline. Fix the 'send play data' gap to the 64px row pitch or add a divider.

P1 right detail pane: Anchor the description 16px under the title. Use 20px tx-1 at 85% for the body. Add a real use of the pane, such as a volume bar for the focused row, or shrink the pane to content height.

P2 value column, arrows and values: Right-align the value group: arrow, value (min-width 120px, centred), arrow, at 16px gaps. Dim arrows on unfocused rows to --ui-line-hi and show them in tx-1 or lime only on the focused row. Make labels tx-2 and values tx-1.
P2 focused row 'master volume': Keep the 3px lime left bar and raise the fill to --ui-raised plus a 1px --ui-line-hi top and bottom border. Show the label in tx-1. Leave lime for the value only.

71-settings-sec-controller.verdict: The shell is clean and on style guide (centred card, x top right, lime focus, all lower case), but the controller tab is cluttered with unrelated display rows, the detail pane is mostly empty, and text is small and dim for couch reading.
findings: P1 middle list, rows after vibration strength: Show only the 5 pad rows here (pad buttons, rumble, sensitivity, deadzone, invert, vibration) and move the rest to display. If they must stay, add a 32px section header with a 1px --ui-line divider and a brighter 6px scrollbar.

P1 right detail pane: Cut the sentence to a short callout (e.g. 'swap pad buttons') at 20px directly under the title with 16px gap. Add a pad button map or the current binding summary in the empty space. Never leave a floating paragraph.
P1 row labels and values, left nav idle items: Row names and values 20px f-cond 600 in --tx-1. Nav items 20px, idle in --tx-2 at 4.5:1 or better. Row height 56px.

P2 focused row 'pad buttons': Use one focus treatment for both lists: --ui-raised fill plus 3px lime left bar. Draw the action as a 36px-tall button with 1px --ui-line-hi border, or add a right chevron.
P2 value column, arrows: Enlarge the arrows to 24px, put them 40px either side of the value, and give them a 40x40 hit area that lights lime on focus.

73-settings-sec-accessibility.verdict: The new screen is cleaner, with one focus, the lime pick-file slab gone and a short description. But the focused row has lost its fill and bar, the settings list is a flat wall of same-weight rows, and the right pane is mostly empty.
findings: P1 colour-blind mode row (first row, focused): Restore the --ui-raised row fill and a 3px --acc bar on the left edge. Add 16px top padding in the scroll list so the focused row never touches the panel border.

P1 right detail pane: Show the current value at hero size (56px, f-cond 800, lime) under the title. Add a 16px tx-2 hint line such as 'left / right change'. Alternatively narrow the pane to about 480px and give the list the extra width.

P1 settings list rows: Add 16px tx-2 group labels with 32px spacing above them ('visual', 'player 2', 'data', 'dev'). Give every row the same 56px height and drop the stray blank bands. Give every value cell the same style: tx-1 for the value, with chevrons only on the focused row.
P1 pick file button: Put 'restore from a backup' and a 160x40 outlined 'pick file' button on one 56px row, with the button right-aligned in the value column. Use the lime fill only on focus.
P2 left nav rail: Remove the odd 24px gap, or add a 1px divider and a 'data' group label there. Set a 56px row height on every tab for consistent rhythm. Reduce the rail to about 220px.

27-settings-scroll-600.verdict: The focused row now sits fully inside the list with no clipping at the top or bottom, which fixes the worst flaw of the old shot, but the screen is still a flat template with a mostly empty detail pane and weak section structure.
findings: P1 right detail pane: Put the current value at 56px hero size (f-cond 800, lime) under the 32px title, then show a 12px volume bar or a preview below it. Or narrow the pane to about 480px and give the list the extra width.

P1 list rows, value column: Narrow the row so the label and value are at most 420px apart, and enlarge the chevrons to 24px. Draw volume rows with a thin 6px fill bar. Leave idle values in tx-1 and make only the focused value lime.
P1 audio and controls groups, y≈585-620: Add a 16px tx-2 section label ('controls') above the keys row and move those rows to the controls tab. Fade the bottom 32px of the list to the panel colour.
P2 focus row (music volume): Raise the focus fill to #262b2f or draw a 1px lime-at-30% top and bottom edge. Drop the lighter border.
P2 left tab column: Make the selected tab text lime or tx-1 at full strength. Pin 'send play data' to the bottom of the column, or fold it into 'saves and tools'.

j8-p1-pad-lost.verdict: Clean, consistent card with a clear lime primary and a proper title and x, but it is a generic pause-menu clone that carries no pad-lost context, and it has a bare black background, a stray top-tab, small type and an unevenly weighted button stack.
findings: P1 whole screen / title: Add a 32px pad glyph (or a 'player 1' label in tx-2 at 16px) beside the title, and show the live prompt on the reconnect button (e.g. 'reconnect  [a]' at 16px, acc-ink).
P1 background: Keep the frozen game frame behind it under a rgba(6,7,8,.80) scrim, or make the card follow the window rule. Either way, drop the pure-black void.
P1 button stack: Keep only reconnect, settings and end run here. Move feedback, report and what's new to the normal pause menu. Give 'end run' a 1px --danger border at the same 56px height.
P2 button text: Set button text to 20px f-cond 600 tx-1. Keep 16px for hints only.
P2 card top-left accent tab: Draw it at full --acc, 2px tall, starting at x=760 (the content edge), or remove it.

j8-p1-press-a.verdict: The card is cleaner and its hierarchy is clear, with one lime resume button, a quiet stack, a red end run and a corner x. The title still reads as a pad prompt rather than a pause, and the card is small and floats on a flat black void.
findings: P1 card title 'p1 press a': Title it 'paused' in --tx-1 at 32px/700. Put 'p1 press a' on a 16px line under the title: 'p1' in amber, 'press a' in --tx-2. If it is a pad-lost card, drop the menu buttons and show a 56px hero 'press a'.
P1 whole screen background: Render the frozen raid frame under a rgba(6,7,8,.80) scrim. If a 90% card is not wanted for a pause, widen it to about 560px and keep it centred.

P1 button stack, rows 3 and 4: Keep resume, settings, feedback and end run. Merge report a problem into feedback and move what's new into settings. Use four full-width rows, each 56px high, with 16px gaps.
P2 end run button: Add 24px of extra space above end run. Brighten the text to about #ff6a4f, or use tx-1 on a --danger 1px border. Add a confirm step.
P2 top-left of card edge at about x=720..756, y=298: Remove it, or make it a deliberate 3px x 40px --acc bar inset 0 from the card edge and aligned with the content at x=760.

j8-p1-sees-p2-lost.verdict: The new 'p2 pad lost' tag is a clean, readable dark panel with a pad glyph, but it floats mid-screen and competes with the toasts above it. The surrounding HUD still has mixed panel styles, different sizes and a cluttered top centre.
findings: P1 p2 pad lost tag, centre screen (820-1100, 295-355): Anchor it to player 2: 16px above the 'player 2' name tag, centred on them. Or put it in the player 2 corner card at left (16,324). Use the same panel fill (#16191b at 90%) and 1px --ui-line-hi border as the other HUD panels.

P1 top centre stack: team score, extract, golden enemy, stronghold, p2 pad lost: Keep one hero (the timer or sp at 56px). Merge the two toasts into the bottom-left feed and delete the top duplicates. Give the warning tag its own slot below the score card with 8px spacing. Raise the small sp lines to the 16px label minimum.

P1 Panel styling across the HUD: score card, run info, ammo card, hotbar, status pills, p2 tag: Use one panel for all of them: fill #16191b at 90%, 1px #4a5257 border, 4px radius, 24px padding. Use the 3px lime tab on one 'star' panel only, and use warn amber (#f5b73b) for the pad-lost bar so it reads as a warning rather than the accent.
P1 'p2 pad lost' title text: Set the text at 20px f-cond 600 tx-1. Make the glyph 24px --warn. Use a --warn 3px left bar. Add a 16px tx-2 'reconnect' sub-line only if it is a real action.

P2 Bottom left: standing tag, armour, stamina, hp bars, feed pills: Make all three bars the same 20px height with 16px labels at 8px gaps. Align the feed pills to the bar column's left edge (24px margin). Give every feed row an icon or none. Drop the 'standing' box border.

j8-p2-pad-lost.verdict: A clean, calm pause card with a clear lime primary and tidy lower-case type, but it reads as a generic pause menu: tiny in a black void, with no player context, no focus state, and chrome buttons that crowd out the pad-lost message.
findings: P1 whole screen / card: Dim the live raid behind it with a --scrim rgba(6,7,8,.80) layer instead of pure black. Either widen the card toward the window rule, or keep it small as a modal and add a context line: a 'p2' tag (16px f-cond, tx-2) above the title, or 'pad lost' with a 56px hero glyph.

P1 menu buttons (settings, report a problem, feedback, what's new): Keep reconnect, settings and end run. Move feedback, what's new and report a problem into settings, or shrink them to a 14px footer legend row. This cuts the card height by about 200px.
P1 reconnect button: Add a 24px pad-button glyph left of 'reconnect'. Give every non-primary row a visible focus state: a 2px --acc border or a --ui-raised fill, plus a 3px lime left bar.
P2 top-left accent tab: Brighten it to full --acc and align it with the title's left edge at x=760 (24px inset), or remove it.
P2 title row and X: Make the X a 40x40 hit box with a 1px --ui-line-hi border on focus. Centre it on the title's cap-height (y=349) and right-align it to the 760-1160 content column.

j8-p2-press-a.verdict: The panel is clean and consistent (lime main action, red end run, x in the corner), but the screen's real job, 'press a' after a pad was lost, is a small title above a pause menu, so the player can't tell what happened or what to do.
findings: P0 title 'press a' (top-left of card): Make the live prompt the hero: 56px f-cond 800 tx-1, centred above the buttons, with a 16px tx-2 label above it that names the player and the cause (e.g. 'p2 pad lost'). Drop 'press a' from the title slot and use 'paused' or the player label there. Put a pad glyph for the button on the resume button.

P1 whole screen / scrim: If this stays a compact pause card, scale it up to about 640x720 with 24px button text and 72px rows, or follow the guide and go to a 90% card. Show the frozen raid behind a .80 scrim rather than flat #0b0c0d.

P1 button stack (resume, settings, report a problem, feedback, what's new): Keep resume, settings, end run. Move report a problem, feedback and what's new into settings or a single 'more' row. If they stay, make them one consistent full-width ghost row each at 56px high with 16px gaps.

P1 'end run' at bottom: Give it the ghost button shape with a 1px --danger border and --danger text at 20px 600. Align it to the same 400px column and 56px height, 24px below the stack, and label the confirm step on press.

P2 focus state on the buttons: Idle border --ui-line-hi #4a5257 at 1px with a --ui-raised fill. Focus: 2px --acc border plus a 3px lime left bar. Keep the lime fill only for the one primary action, not for the focused row.

j8-p2-sees-p1-lost.verdict: The new 'p1 pad lost' tag is readable and sits where the eye lands, but it is stacked into a crowded mid-screen column of banners, and the HUD around it is loosely styled and inconsistent with the style guide.
findings: P1 center banner stack (golden enemy, stronghold, p1 pad lost): Show one notice at a time at the top centre. Drop the duplicate left-edge list or the centre pills. Centre the lost tag on x=960 and give all three the same 4px radius, panel fill #16191b at 90% and a 1px #4a5257 border. Only the lost tag gets the 3px accent bar.
P1 p1 pad lost tag: Make the bar and glyph --warn #f5b73b and widen the bar to 4px. Add a 16px tx-2 line such as 'press a to rejoin', and keep the title at 32px f-cond 700.
P1 top-right 'run info' panel: Collapse it to the goals only, set the heading to 16px tx-2, rows to 20px tx-1, and right-align the sp values in tx-2. Inset it 48px from the edge with 24px padding.

P1 team score block, top centre: Make the hero value 56px f-cond 800. Raise the sublabels to 16px tx-2. Merge the extract pill into the same panel, or align it to the panel width. Add 1px #4a5257 and a 4px radius, and give the panel 8px top padding.

P2 bottom-left vitals (armour, stamina, hp): Use one bar height of 20px and one 16px label size. Use --ok for hp, a neutral fill for stamina, and a --ui-line track for all three. Inset them 48px from the edge and space them 8px apart. Keep hp as the largest because it is the vital one.

j7-hub-p1-pad-owner.verdict: The hub reads as a cluttered prototype: the station labels are huge and compete with each other, the HUD text is tiny, the accents don't follow the style guide, and the hotbar is heavy for a hub.
findings: P0 station labels (wirt the gambler, enter raid!, the mainframe, shop craft and hire, settings, the stash, the last pour, fashion): Drop the labels to 20px f-cond 600 on a --ui-panel pill with 8px 16px padding and a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Make only 'enter raid!' a lime (--acc) pill with --acc-ink text, or put a 3px lime bar on it. Remove the '!'. Place every label 16px above its station, not over the character.

P0 top-left and top-right HUD (the undercroft, 0 items in stash, $900, 0 xp, stash $0 bag $0): Put the title at 32px f-cond 700 in tx-1, with the subtitle at 16px tx-2 and 24px inset from the screen edge. Group the career numbers in one panel with a $ hero at 56px, and the other numbers at 16px tx-2. Use --acc, not amber, for the one highlighted item.
P1 hotbar (bottom centre): Hide the empty slots in the hub, or shrink the bar to 64px cells and show only the owned ones. Set the numerals at 16px, and use --acc for the 2px focus border.
P1 'experimental feature may glitch' below the last pour: Replace it with a 16px 'experimental' tag in --warn on a small panel pill attached to the label, with no asterisks and no sentence.

P1 player markers (pillager name, p1 tag, the rings under the characters): Set the name at 16px f-cond 600 with the p1 badge in the same pill (20px tall, 4px radius) directly above the head. Keep the ring colours as they are, since the colour choice is pending.

j7-hub-p2-pad-owner.verdict: The hub reads as a prototype, not a polished menu: the room labels are all the same size and weight, the top HUD text is tiny and scattered, and a capital letter, an explaining sentence and a clipped caption sit next to the player.
findings: P0 the last pour label and its caption: Delete the sentence. If a flag is needed, use a 16px f-cond tag 'experimental' in --warn on a --ui-panel chip, 8px below the label, with no asterisks.

P0 top-left title block 'the undercroft / 0 items in stash · 0 runs': Place the title at x=48, y=40 (the 5% margin) in f-cond 700 32px --tx-1. Put the subline below it in 16px --tx-2 with 8px between. Keep the 'stash' figures out of this block, since they repeat in the top right.

P1 top-right HUD: $900 / 0 xp / stash $0 bag $0: Switch to the cw-trcol vertical list: every row 20px f-cond 600, label in --tx-2 at 16px, value in --tx-1 right-aligned, 8px row gap, 48px from the right edge. Use one --ui-panel at 90% with 1px --ui-line-hi.

P1 station labels (wirt the gambler, enter raid!, the mainframe, shop craft and hire, settings, the stash, the last pour, fashion): Make secondary labels 20px f-cond 600 --tx-1 on --ui-panel, with 8px/16px padding and a 4px radius. Make 'enter raid' the one 32px label with a 2px lime (--acc) top tab, and drop the '!'. Add a 3px --ui-void halo or move the labels out so they do not cover NPCs.

P1 bottom centre: 'in pillager's party' chip and 'l stick walk · ls jog · a use station' legend: Put the legend in a --ui-panel strip at 16px f-cond --tx-2 with key glyphs in --tx-1, centred 16px above the hotbar. Move the party chip to the top-left under the title, so it is a status, not a floating tooltip.

j7-raid-p1-pad-owner.verdict: The raid HUD is readable but cluttered: four overlapping notification and legend stacks, mismatched panel styles, and no single hero element.
findings: P0 bottom centre, between the pad legend and the hotbar: Hide the legend during live play. Show it only on hold-view or in the first 10 seconds, as a single-row 16px hint strip. Keep the toast stack at least 24px clear of the hotbar top.

P0 left middle, bottom left, top centre: Use one toast component, anchored in one place, and de-duplicate by id. Remove the centre pills for events already in the left stack. Delete 'gold glow marks the box'. Use one 4px radius, one --ui-panel fill, and a 3px left tab for the type.

P1 top-right career list, minimap, run info: Use equal 40px rows with a label in tx-2 at 16px and a value in tx-1. Add a label to the first row, for example 'cash'. Put 16px gaps between the stack, the minimap and run info, and a 5% margin from the screen edge.

P1 run info panel, 'concealed · in cover' tag, 'extraction c available': Put all status tags in one right-aligned column of 8px-gap pills, with --warn for the warning glyph only. Add 8px between run info and the extraction line. Use tx-2 for objective lines, and lime only for the active one.

P1 hp / stamina bars, bottom left: Put hp and stamina in one --ui-panel card with a 1px border, 8px padding and 4px radius. Use 16px labels left-aligned and the number at 32px. Keep a fixed 24px gap from the hotbar and the screen edge.

j7-raid-p2-pad-owner.verdict: The HUD works as a debug-style stack of unrelated boxes. Nothing leads the eye, the type sizes are inconsistent, and the screen is cluttered with controls help and duplicate toasts.
findings: P0 centre-bottom, controls legend (l stick / b / rt ...) at about 495-900 x 715-865: Remove it from the raid HUD, or show it once and fade it after 5s. If kept, make it a P panel (#16191b at 90%, 1px #4a5257, 4px radius, 24px padding) with 16px labels in tx-1 and 16px actions in tx-2. Limit it to the 4 actions in use.

P0 bottom-left vitals (standing / stamina / hp 100): Use one bar component: 24px tall, 4px radius, #16191b track with a 1px border, a label at 16px f-cond 600 inside with 8px padding, and the value right-aligned. Reserve the single hero size (56px) for ammo. Inset the block to 5% margins (96px left, 54px bottom). Make the stance a small 16px tag above the bars.

P1 top-right career column ($900 / xp 0 / stash $0 / backpack $120): Keep this corner alone per the pending cw-trcol order, but make sure each row is a consistent 40px high with 8px gaps. Add a label to the first row, and drop xp when it is 0. Match the minimap and run info panels to the P spec (#16191b, 1px #4a5257, 4px radius, 24px padding) with a 16px label size.

P1 run info panel (right, 1605-1900 x 515-695): Cut the text to short callouts such as 'haul $1,200  0/1', 'data core  0/1', 'cases  0/2'. Set the header at 16px tx-2, and the rows at 20px tx-1 with the 0/1 counters right-aligned in lime when active. Use 8px row gaps and 16px padding on all sides.

P1 top-left raid scoreboard 'current pillager bots 3' and the 'pillager' nameplate card: Make the scoreboard header tx-2 16px, with row text at 20px tx-1 and values right-aligned. Collapse it to the top 3 lines. Align the name card and the scoreboard to the same 96px left margin, and use the P panel spec on both.

79-settings-experimental.verdict: The 61b version fixes the repeated chip and the double focus box, but 28 lime 'on' chips now outshout everything, and the actual focus is a faint row tint that is hard to see.
findings: P0 every row's 'on' chip: Make the 'on' state quiet: tx-1 text on a transparent chip with a 1px --ui-line-hi border, or a small 8px lime dot plus 'on' in tx-1. Show 'off' in tx-2. Keep a lime fill only for the focused row's control.

P0 focused row 'run goals': On the focused row, add a 2px --acc outline or a full-width 4px lime left bar. Raise the row fill to #262b2f and make the label 22px with tx-1 at 100%. Show the ‹ › arrows on the focused row only, in lime.
P1 chip column position: Right-align chips to the row's inner padding of 24px, which is x~1014. Use a fixed 56x32 chip so every row aligns to the same right edge.

P1 bottom row 'elite affixes': Use a clean 24px fade mask on the list, applied to the chip too, or clip the list at a row boundary. Make the scrollbar 6px wide in --ui-line-hi, and add a position indicator, e.g. '1 / 28' in the header in place of '28 features'.

P1 detail pane: Put the on/off state in the pane as a 56px hero word ('on' in lime, 'off' in tx-2) under the title, then the description at 20px. Raise 'starts next raid' to 16px tx-2. Pin it to the bottom of the pane as a note, or drop it.
