P2 header row (pre-raid, cold storage, ascending here chip, stats line): Set 'pre-raid' to 32px f-cond 700 and 'cold storage' to 20px. Right-align the stats line at 16px in --tx-2 with a 24px inner margin. Turn the chip into plain text with a check glyph, or drop the check.

d151-incoming-p1.verdict: The scrim is now darker and blurred, but the card is still a small 558x255 box with an empty leaderboard, a bordered × and a tiny 'keyboard' tag, so little of the earlier advice was applied.
findings: P1 empty state, 'no scores yet' and the dead space under the title: Draw 3 to 5 ghost rows with rank, name and sp at 40% opacity and 1px --ui-line dividers. Centre 'no scores yet' in 20px --tx-2. Keep the gap between title and body at 24px.
P1 card size, 558x255 at screen centre: Enlarge the card to about 720x440, or 90% for the full list. Use 32px inner padding, a 4px radius and a --scrim of rgba(6,7,8,.80).
P1 '×' button, top-right: Drop the border and fill and draw a 16px --tx-2 × at a 24px inset. Show it only for mouse or touch input. Make a 32px hit area for those inputs.

P2 'press any key' prompt, bottom-right: Set it at 24px 700 --tx-1 with a 24px lime key chip showing the device glyph. Pulse opacity from 70% to 100% over 1.5s. Align it to the same 32px inset as the title.
P2 'keyboard' tag, top centre, y≈19: Set it at 14px --tx-2 on a --ui-panel chip with 8px padding, 24px from the top edge. Or fold it into the prompt as 'press any key (keyboard)'.

d151-incoming-p2.verdict: This is a clean, calm title card with one clear lime action, but the earlier HUD advice no longer applies to this picture. The amber gradient wordmark, undersized secondary text and save-management clutter keep it from reading as polished.
findings: P1 player 2 title, 'player 2 window' under the main button: Add a 16px cyan 'player 2' chip with a 4px radius above the title. Make the live prompt the primary action at 20px, for example 'press any key to join', naming the device's key. Delete the loose grey label.

P1 wordmark 'pillagers', centre: Fill the wordmark flat in --tx-1 #efe9dc, f-cond 800, with no gradient or shadow. Use about 96px as the one hero size. Keep the lime fill on the button as the only hot colour.

P1 saves block (saves label, save row, name input, change name, create a new save): Collapse it to one 20px row of 'pillager new · $900' with the stats in tx-2. Move the name input, change name and create a new save into a settings or save window. Set the 'saves' label to 16px f-cond 600 in tx-2 at at least 4.5:1.
P2 top centre 'keyboard' chip: Move it to the 48px/48px top-left as a 16px chip. Colour it by player: amber for P1 and cyan for P2. Use --extract only for extraction.

P2 top right, 'go fullscreen' and 'settings' buttons: Inset them 48px from the top and right. Use 16px f-cond 600 with 16px side padding and a 1px --ui-line-hi border at 4px radius. Keep the height at 40px.

d151-lmg-p1.verdict: The easy-mode modal and stray sliver are gone, and the ammo card now has a clear hero number. The top-centre stack, hotbar and hp bar still don't match each other.
findings: P1 top-centre stack (timer, team score, extract pill): Use one 240px column with a 4px radius and 8px gaps. Timer at 32px. Put the score on one line with 'team score' at 16px tx-2 and the number at 32px. Put the you/p2 split on one 16px line, with you in amber and p2 in cyan. Add an 8px gap above the extract pill and move the storm icon inside the timer panel.

P1 hotbar, bottom centre: Draw all 10 slots as 64px tiles with --ui-panel fill, a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 8px gaps. Put the number at 16px in the top-left of each tile. Dim empty slots to 40%. Mark the equipped slot with a 2px --acc border. Drop the 'f' badge or make it a 16px label.

P1 bottom-left hp bar: Use a 320x20 bar on a --ui-panel track with a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Put a 16px 'hp' label at 8px inset and the number on the right. Set the margin to 48px from the screen edge. Put the f1 controls chip 16px above or beside it, or fold it into the left feed. Add an armour bar in --r-rare 8px above the hp bar.

P1 bottom-right ammo card, 'support mg 54 / 240': Shrink the card to fit its content with 16px padding. Name at 16px tx-2. Magazine count at 56px f-cond 800 in tx-1. Reserve at 32px 600 in tx-2. Set a 48px margin matching the hp bar.

P2 world labels near the sentry (damage numbers, 'sentry t-77', 'weak spot 2.0x', 'player 2'): Use one tag style: 16px f-cond 600 on a --scrim pill with a 4px radius. Colour only the hit number: tx-1 for normal, --warn for crit. Stagger the damage numbers 24px apart vertically and remove the '!' or turn it into a 16px glyph.

d151-lmg-p2.verdict: The HUD is readable and mostly lower case, but its panels still differ in width, padding and fill, and the damage popups, hp bar and empty weapon slots are still loose and unframed.
findings: P1 top-centre cluster: clock, team score, extract chip: Make all three panels 270px wide, centred, stacked with 8px gaps. Use one --ui-panel fill at 90% with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius. Add 16px padding in the score panel and give the per-player rows an 8px gap at 16px tx-2. Move the sun icon inside the clock panel. Put a 60% dark pill behind 'packing floor'.

P1 weapon slots along the bottom (x670-1480, y955-1055): Draw all 10 slots as 72x72 tiles with 8px gaps. Fill them with --ui-panel at 85% and give the empty ones a 1px --ui-line border. Keep the 2px --acc border only on the selected slot. Put the numbers at 16px tx-2 in the top-left corner of every tile. Centre the row 24px from the bottom.

P1 hp bar, bottom-left (x24-430, y1035-1068): Put the bar in a 320x32 --ui-panel frame with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius, 24px from the left and bottom edges. Use a 16px 'hp' label and a 20px value, with --ok for the fill. Give the player 1 plate the same frame and anchor it directly above the bar.

P1 damage numbers and tags above the sentry (x790-990, y360-480): Draw the damage numbers at 32px f-cond 800, one size, and colour only by owner (P1 amber, P2 cyan). Put the tags at 16px on a 60% dark pill with 8px gaps. Drop the '!' or turn it into a 16px 'crit' tag. Keep the tags off the sprite with 8px clearance.

P1 bottom-right: air strike bar and 'support mg' ammo panel: Make both panels 300px wide, 24px from the right edge, with a 16px gap. Make the air strike bar 8px high, with --warn fill until ready, then --acc. Put '8%' at 16px tx-1 with 16px clearance from the bar. Put the 'support mg' label top-left at 16px tx-2 and the ammo on one baseline, 54 at 56px hero and '/ 240' at 32px tx-2.

d151-shotgun-p1.verdict: The HUD is still a set of mismatched boxes. Almost none of the earlier advice was applied: the top-centre stack is still three different widths, the hp bar is still a bare bar, the slots are still uneven, and the goals chip is still a different style from the others.
findings: P1 top-centre stack (timer, team score card, extract pill): Use one 240px column. Show the 10:00 timer at 56px. Below it put one 16px line, 'extract 114m', in --extract. Drop the 'team score' label and the you/p2 text. Show 0 sp at 20px --tx-1. Use 16px padding on every card, a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Move the weather icon into the card as a 16px glyph.

P1 bottom-left hp bar: Put it in a --ui-panel card with a 4px radius, 24px from the left and bottom edges. Make the bar 16px tall in --ok. Put a 20px --tx-1 'hp 100' label above it. Align the bottom edge with the slot bar and the ammo card at y 1056.

P1 weapon slot bar (bottom centre): Draw all 10 slots as 64px frames with a --ui-panel fill and a 1px --ui-line-hi border, spaced 16px apart. Show empty slots at 40% opacity with the ghost icon inside the frame. Put the 16px number in the top-left of every frame. Use a 3px --acc border on the selected slot only. Move the 'f' chip to the bottom-left inside the frame or remove it.

P1 ammo card (bottom right): Set 'riot scattergun' to 20px --tx-2. Set the 6 to 56px --tx-1 and '/ 240' to 20px --tx-2 on the same baseline. Use 24px from the right and bottom edges and 16px padding, the same as the hp card.

P1 goals 0/3 chip (top right): Use the same card style as the other HUD panels: --ui-panel, 1px --ui-line-hi, 4px radius, 16px padding, 20px type. Shrink the card to fit its content, with a 16px chevron. Put the top edge at y 24 and the right edge at 24px.

d151-shotgun-p2.verdict: The in-world tags and damage numbers are merged and tidier, but the hp bar, the stacked top-centre panels and the weapon slot row still follow the same loose, mixed-style pattern as before, so the HUD is only a little closer to the style guide.
findings: P1 hp bar, bottom-left: Put it in a --ui-panel box with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius, 48px from the left and 32px from the bottom. Make the fill 12px high and about 280px wide, in --ok. Set 'hp 100' as 20px/600 in --tx-1 beside the bar, not on it.

P1 top-centre stack (clock, team score, extract chip): Make all three panels 270px wide, centred, with 8px gaps and a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Set the per-player lines to 16px/600 with 16px of right padding. Use 'you' and 'p2' consistently. Render the location name at 16px in --tx-2 above the clock, not in purple.

P1 weapon slot row, bottom-centre: Draw every slot as a 72px --ui-panel tile with an 8px gap, a 4px radius, a 1px --ui-line border and a 16px number in --tx-2. Mark the selected tile with a 3px --acc border. Drop the per-slot ammo on the idle tile. Move the party chip to the top-left under 'keyboard' and anchor 'f1 controls' to the left edge of the row.

P1 right-bottom stack (air strike bar, weapon card): Make both panels 300px wide with a shared right margin of 48px and 8px between them. Use 16px/600 labels, a 6px fill in --acc and 16px of inner padding.

P2 damage numbers, 'sentry k-13' and 'weak spot 3.4x' tags: Use one floating column. Put 'weak spot 3.4x' at 16px/600 in --warn above the number. Move the sentry tag 24px above the sprite and use the same dark chip style as the other world tags. Keep damage numbers at 20px with a 2px dark outline.

p1-feed-large.verdict: This is a clean, lower-case run-over card with a clear hero number and a visible live prompt, but the card is small and left-heavy, it repeats the score, and its type is undersized for a couch.
findings: P1 score block and p1 row: With one player, drop the p1 'score' column, or hide the team-score block. Show the team total only when there are two or more players (p1 and p2).

P1 whole card, 718x398 px centred: Widen the card to about 960px (50% of the width) or tighten it to about 560px. Set the padding to 32px. Put the hero number and the stat row on one grid, with the stats spread across the full width.

P1 stat labels 'score / kills / extractions / deaths' and 'team score': Keep the labels at 16px minimum with +.04em tracking, but use tx-1 at 80% (around #cfc9bc) or confirm 4.5:1 or better. Make the stat values 32px (--fs-title) instead of about 28px. Leave 8px between the number and its label.

P2 'press any key' prompt, bottom right: Raise it to 24px with the lime ring at 28px. Add a 16px gap before it, and consider centring it or putting it on the same baseline as the title row. Optionally pulse the ring (--m-med) to show it is live.
P2 title 'run over': Put 24px below the title and 8px between the label and the hero number, so that 'team score' reads as the hero's caption. Align everything to the 8px grid.

p1-feed-normal.verdict: This is a clean, lower-case run-over card with a clear hero number and a live prompt. It is small and generic, the score appears twice, and the card is mostly empty space.
findings: P1 card overall (601-1318 x 341-738): Add a 4px lime or extract-teal bar on the card's top or left edge. Widen the card to about 960px, or move the hero score to the right in an 80px hero. Put the title and a short status word such as 'extracted' or 'kia' in the header row.

P1 hero 'team score 0 sp' vs the p1 row 'score 0 sp': Drop the 'score' column from the player row, since the hero already carries it. Show the p1 row only when there are two or more players. Make the stat values 20px f-cond 600 in tx-1 and the labels 16px tx-2, so the 56px hero clearly dominates.

P1 'press any key' prompt (1106-1286, 672-702): Centre the prompt or span it across the bottom of the card. Use 24px lime (--acc) text and a pulse on the ring, with a divider above it and 24px padding. Make the ring 40px and keep it vertically centred on the text.
P2 title 'run over': Set the title to 32px f-cond 700 and the hero to 56px f-cond 800. Use 24px top padding and put 24px between the title and the 'team score' label.

P2 p1 stat row (y 565-640): Make the p1 chip a 24px amber pill with ink text and centre it vertically against the value. Use four equal columns across the full 652px inner width. Add 16px padding above and below the divider.

p2-feed-large.verdict: The modal is tidy and lower case, but it is a small, mostly empty card. 'no scores yet' is dim and tiny, the prompt is a little small, and a half-visible background lobby competes with the card.
findings: P1 card body, 'no scores yet': Make the empty state 20px tx-1/tx-2 with ≥4.5:1 contrast. Set rows on the 8px grid (title 32, body 24 above and below). Or hide the card and show only the prompt, so no dead copy remains.

P1 prompt row, 'player 2: press any key': Raise the prompt to a 32px hero-weight line (f-cond 700), centred or left-aligned under the title, and drop the radio-dot affordance for a key glyph. Add a gentle bounce pulse. Keep lime only on the dot or key glyph.
P1 background lobby: Raise the scrim to .80 per the guide (it looks near .55 now) and blur harder. Remove or enlarge the 'keyboard' chip to at least 16px with contrast ≥4.5:1.
P2 close x, top right of the card: Remove it here (any key continues). If kept, use a 40px target with a --ui-line-hi border and no box fill.
P2 card top edge, lime tick: Extend it to a 3px full-width top bar, or align it to the title's text left edge (x=713) and use it as the title underline.

p2-feed-normal.verdict: A small, empty modal over a blurred lobby: the title, the empty-state line and the prompt are all about the same size, so nothing leads, and the card is tiny, generic and mostly dead space.
findings: P1 card hierarchy: Make the prompt 28-32px tx-1 with a bigger lime focus ring. Drop 'no scores yet' to 16px tx-2. Keep the title at 32px but not bold at the same time as the prompt, so only one thing is bold.

P1 card size vs style guide: Either use the 90% card or treat it as a small dialog and darken the scrim to .80 so the lobby sprites don't show through. Right now the lobby shows through at roughly .45.
P1 empty state: Show 3 ghost rows (rank, name, sp) at 40% opacity, or drop the section and the divider and put the prompt in the body. Keep the padding at 24px on every side.
P2 card padding and alignment: Use a 56px header and a 72px footer on the 8px grid. Put the prompt on the same left edge or centre it, and don't mix the two.
P2 lime top tick: Remove it, or run it as a full-width 3px top rule. Reserve lime for focus, selected and the one action.

p1-feed-after.verdict: The raid HUD is readable, but its panels sit on top of each other, the feed line is cut off, and the pieces use different sizes, fills and accent colours, so it reads as unfinished.
findings: P1 top-centre stack: clock, team score, extract chip: Give the stack one 8px grid with 8px gaps between cards. Use 16px inner padding on the score card. Put 'you' and 'p2' on separate rows with an 8px gap, or turn them into a two-column row. Make the extract chip the same width as the score card, or centre both on the clock.

P1 left feed line 'select a heal · bandage, medkit or armour p...': Shorten the text to something like 'heal: pick a bandage or medkit' that fits. Better, drop it. Add 24px of left margin (5% safe area) and put the bar inside the pill with 8px padding.

P1 bottom HUD: hp bar, 'f1 controls', hotbar, ammo card: Set a 48px left and bottom margin. Make the hp bar 24px tall with 16px text inside it. Render empty slots as dim 4px-radius tiles at the same 96px size. Dock 'f1 controls' on the hotbar's baseline, left of slot 1, as a 16px label. Align the ammo card's bottom edge with the hotbar's.

P1 hierarchy across the HUD: Keep one hero per area: the timer at 56px/800 and the ammo count at 56px. Drop the score to 32px/700 and the sub-scores to 16px muted (--tx-2). Follow the guide: P1 amber is allowed for the player ring, but keep the selected-slot outline consistent with the rest of the game's 'selected' treatment.

P2 minimap and goals chip, top right: Add a 24px right and top margin. Clip the icon cluster inside the map frame, with 8px padding from the edge. Join the goals strip to the minimap as one panel, with a shared border and an 8px radius or less (4px by the guide).

p2-feed-after.verdict: The HUD is readable and mostly calm, with a clear ammo hero number and a clean lower-case feed line. But the team score panel is cramped and overlaps the timer and extract chips, the feed text is cut off, and the corners are crowded and inconsistent.
findings: P1 top-centre team score card: Make the card 320px wide with 16px padding. Put 'team score' (16px, tx-2) on top and '0 sp' (hero 56px, centred) below. Put the per-player rows (16px) on one line beneath, amber for P1 and cyan for P2. Leave an 8px gap under the timer, with no overlap.

P1 left feed line 'select a heal · bandage, medkit or armour p...': Shorten it to 'select a heal' and drop the item list, or widen the box so it never truncates. Inset the box 5% from the screen edge (about 48px) and use a 4px radius. Move the 'f1 controls' chip to the same left edge and align it with the feed.

P1 top-right minimap and 'goals 0/3' chip: Inset the minimap's markers 8px from its border and move the 'n' compass letter to a fixed corner slot. Crop or fill the empty black area. Give the goals chip the same fill and 4px radius as the timer and score panels, 16px label text, and a 48px margin to the screen edge.

P2 hotbar slots 1-4 and numbers 5-0: Draw all 6 slots as 72px frames with a 1px --ui-line-hi border on the --ui-panel fill, and keep empty ones at 40% alpha. Use the lime --acc 2px border for the selected slot only. Use 16px numerals in tx-2. Make the 'f' badge 16px with a panel chip behind it.

P2 bottom-left hp bar: Put the hp bar in a 4px-radius --ui-panel card with 16px padding, and inset it 48px from the left and bottom edges. Put the label in tx-1 at 20px on the dark panel, and the number on the right side at 32px. Use --ok for the fill.

callouts-core-packed.verdict: This is a different screen from the rack card I reviewed before, so I can't judge whether that advice was followed. As a hub it has a strong 'enter raid!' label, but the bottom stack is crowded, the top-right HUD is tiny and scattered, and there are overlaps and stray text throughout.
findings: P1 bottom centre, y≈850-1065: toast, controls strip and hotbar stacked: Delete the controls strip in the hub, or fold it into one 16px tx-2 line. Move the toast above the stack with a 24px gap, with 16px tx-1 text on --ui-panel, and shorten it to 'core slotted'. Show only the owned hotbar slots, and keep the empty ones at 40% opacity with no icon.

P1 top-right HUD, y≈20-40: '$900  0 xp  stash $0 bag $0': Build it as the cw-trcol vertical list: each row 20px f-cond 600, tx-1 value with a 16px tx-2 label, rows 32px apart, right-aligned to the 5% margin (96px). Remove 'stash $0 bag $0' or merge it into the title card.
P1 '***experimental feature may glitch***' at (1510, 764): Delete it. If a flag is needed, use a 16px --warn word 'beta' inside the 'the last pour' label, with no asterisks and no second box.

P1 station labels versus characters: 'the last pour', 'the stash', 'fashion' and 'shop, craft, and hire': Place every label at a fixed 12px above the pad ring and draw it above the sprites with a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Remove the stray second zone circle. Give each station a single 2px ring.
P1 'enter raid!' at (960, 118): Use 'enter raid' with no '!'. Put it in a --ui-panel chip with a 1px --acc border and 8px padding. Add a 16px tx-2 'e' key hint beneath it, 8px away.

callouts-rack-parts.verdict: This picture is the undercroft hub with a 'not enough parts' toast. The rack-build screen the earlier review covered isn't visible, so nothing from that advice can be judged as fixed, and the hub has its own hierarchy and clutter problems.
findings: P0 the last pour label, at (1510,764): Delete the sentence. If a flag is needed, use a 16px 'beta' chip in --warn on --ui-panel, with no asterisks, anchored 8px under the station label.

P0 the screen the review was meant to show (rack build / import a friend): Recapture with the rack window open at 1080p. Show a centred 90% card with a 56px header, an x in the corner, and the three action buttons.

P1 enter raid! at the top centre (850-1070, 90-145): Change it to 'enter raid' at --fs-title 32px in --acc, with no '!'. Put it on a --ui-panel plate with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 3px --acc bottom bar.

P1 not enough parts toast at (960,870), and the controls hint at (960,918): Move the toast to the top-centre banner slot. Give it a --danger left bar and a 4.5:1 label. Keep at least 24px between the toast, the controls strip and the hotbar.

P1 top-right currency strip at (1660-1900, 15-40): Use one 20px f-cond tx-1 line per item in a vertical list, with a --ui-panel plate behind it and 16px padding. Keep the labels at 16px tx-2. Remove the mixed sizes.

callouts-raid-host.verdict: The HUD tells you what it needs to, but the controls panel is a large always-open block that covers the left of the map, a toast is clipped behind it, and type sizes and panel styles vary from corner to corner.
findings: P0 centre-left toast 'bandage, medkit or armour plate': Centre the toast on the screen and give it a z-index above the controls panel. Alternatively, anchor it above the hotbar at about y=900. Give it 16px padding and a 1px --ui-line-hi border.

P1 controls panel, left, y 505-800: Fold it to a single line of about 40px height at x≈48, y≈1000, with text like 'f1 controls'. Open it only on F1. If it must stay open, cut it to 6 rows and make the labels 16px --tx-2.
P1 controls panel text: Use 16px minimum, --tx-2 at 4.5:1 or better, row pitch 32px, and 16px gaps between groups.

P1 top-left 'current pillagers' panel versus top-right 'run info': Set rows to 16px with 32px row height and the same panel fill, border and 4px radius as run info. Mark 'you' with a 3px lime or amber bar. Align both panels to the 48px margin.
P1 top-centre timer and extract chip: Remove one of the two distance readouts and keep the teal 'extract 152m' chip at 20px. Raise the timer to the 56px hero size, weight 800.

callouts-raid-join.verdict: The raid HUD uses the right tokens, but the open controls list, a clipped tooltip and a crowded set of boxes make it look unfinished.
findings: P0 Left side, tooltip 'andage, medkit or armour plate': Draw it above the controls panel, or move it to the left feed. Keep it at least 16px clear of the panel (x≥340). Anchor it to the hotbar slot or the item it explains. Fix the clipping at the source rather than patching the text.

P1 Controls panel, mid-left (16,505 to 314,800): Start it folded to one line ('f1 controls'), 16px text, at the bottom-left, above the status chips. When opened, use two aligned columns with equal group gaps of 16px, and keep it at or below 240px wide.

P1 Whole HUD, global: Standardise on --ui-panel at 85% opacity, a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Merge 'extract 152m' and 'c 152m' into one element, since it shows the same number twice. Use 16px type for the pillagers list rows. Keep a 16px gap between panels.

P1 Bottom-left, hp 40 bar and chips 'concealed' / 'in cover': Keep the margin at 5% of the screen, about 48px from the bottom and left. Make hp a 56px hero number or a plain 20px label, not outlined text. Use --danger below 30 hp and --ok when healthy. Use one chip style for both status chips with a 16px label, and keep the icons at 24px.
P1 Contract banner, 'contract item nearby · gold glow marks the box': Cut it to 'contract item nearby'. Place it in the left feed with the warn glyph rather than --acc. Remove the gold-glow sentence.

callouts-host-heal.verdict: The in-raid HUD is clean and the one-place-per-line rule holds, with a good hero ammo number. But several elements are tiny, the pickup card is a crowded two-colour sentence, and the player-list panel and the 'run info' dropdown don't match each other or the rest of the HUD.
findings: P1 bottom-centre toast 'select a heal · bandage, medkit or armour plate': Cut to 'heal: 1 bandage · 2 medkit · 3 plate' as 16px f-cond chips anchored 16px above the hotbar. Use one callout style: 4px radius, --ui-panel at 90%, 1px --ui-line-hi border.

P1 left callout 'contract item nearby · gold glow marks the box': Shorten to 'contract item nearby'. Put the 'gold glow' half in the tutorial only. Match the callout shell to the heal toast (--ui-panel, 4px radius, 16px label). Use --warn only for the icon and tx-1 for the text.

P1 top-left 'current pillagers 3' panel: Set rows to 16px f-cond 600 with 28px row height and 16px padding, and tx-2 for the header. Tint the 'you' row with the P1 amber 3px bar. Give the panel the same --ui-panel fill and 4px radius as the other HUD panels.

P1 bottom-left 'hp 100' bar: Inset it 48px from the left and bottom, make it 20px tall with a 4px radius and a 1px --ui-line-hi track, and put 'hp' at 16px label and 100 at 20px in tx-1 inside the bar. Use --ok at about 85% brightness.

P2 top-right 'run info' dropdown: Restyle it as a --ui-panel pill at 4px radius, 16px type, the same chevron as the pillagers panel and 16px padding. Fix the clipped label at x=1893 by keeping a 48px safe margin or fading the label.

callouts-host-revive.verdict: The raid HUD has the right pieces, but it uses too many type sizes, panel styles and accents. Several elements are too small to read from a couch, and the ammo readout is the only part that reads as intentional.
findings: P1 top-left 'current pillagers' panel: Use 16px minimum text on a --ui-panel fill with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Set the row height to 24px and the padding to 8px. Collapse it by default to the single line 'you $162'. Make the header --tx-2 at 16px.

P1 bottom-left controls tag and top-right 'run info': Make the 'f1 controls' tag 16px with a 24px key chip on a --ui-panel fill, placed 16px above the hotbar's left edge. Restyle 'run info' to the same 4px-radius panel with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 16px --tx-1 text.

P1 center toast 'self-revive spent · one per raid': Move it to the top-centre banner slot under the clock, or the left feed. Shorten it to 'self-revive spent'. Use the same 4px-radius panel and 20px type as the extract banner, and fade it after 3s.

P1 hotbar, bottom centre: Draw all 8 slots as 72px --ui-panel tiles with a 1px --ui-line border and a 16px --tx-2 number. Make the selected slot's 3px border --acc only. Remove the ghost silhouettes or drop them to 15% opacity.

P2 world labels: 'packing floor', 'the forge', 'the seal 0%', 'chi...': Use one label style: 16px f-cond 600, --tx-1, with a 2px dark outline and no letter spacing. Use colour only for state (--acc for the interactable the player is near). Clamp labels to 24px inside the screen edge.

callouts-join-heal.verdict: The in-raid HUD has a strong ammo hero number, but it is a stack of mismatched, tiny, low-contrast widgets, with several callouts and small labels competing at different sizes and no consistent panel language.
findings: P1 top-left 'current pillagers' list: Raise rows to 16px label type on a 32px pitch. Use --ui-panel fill with a 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius and 16px padding. Colour the P1 row amber and the others --tx-2, and keep values in tabular f-cond 600.

P1 mid-screen callout 'select a heal · bandage, medkit or armour plate': Cut it to a short label such as 'heal: 1 bandage 2 medkit', or move it into the left feed. Make it a single shared callout component at 16px with a 4px radius, --ui-panel fill and a 3px left accent bar. Place it 48px above the hotbar.

P1 callouts: 'contract item nearby · gold glow marks the box' and 'select a heal': Use one callout component. Put it on the 5% (96px) left margin, with --tx-1 text and a 3px --warn bar only for warnings. Shorten the copy to 'contract item nearby'.

P1 hp bar bottom-left: Inset it to 48px from the bottom and 96px from the left. Use a 24px-tall bar, a --ui-line track, an --ok fill, and the number in --tx-1 at 20px f-cond 700 with 8px padding. Align the baseline with the hotbar slot bottoms.

P2 hotbar slots 3-0 and 'f1 controls' chip: Draw empty slots as 72px boxes with a 1px --ui-line border at 40% opacity and 16px numbers. Delete the ghost silhouettes. Align the controls chip's left edge with the hp bar and use the same 16px chip style.

callouts-join-revive.verdict: A busy raid HUD whose callout works as a banner, but it sits mid-screen over the walls where the eye never looks. The hud is scattered across mixed type sizes, the panels are unrelated, and there are stray capitals and clutter.
findings: P0 top-right 'run info' dropdown, and the right edge text 'chi': Restyle 'run info' as a --ui-panel card with a 1px --ui-line-hi border, a 4px radius and 16px label type, in the cw-trcol corner list. Remove the 'chi' fragment or keep it inside the 5% margin (96px).

P1 'self-revive spent · one per raid' callout, center ~y653: Move the alert to the top-centre banner slot below the clock. Cut it to 'self-revive spent'. Use a --ui-panel fill with a 3px --warn left bar and 20px f-cond 600 text.

P1 'current pillagers 3' list, top-left: Use 24px row height and 16px --tx-2 labels. Make the 'you' row --tx-1 with an amber 3px left bar. Make the header 16px, 600, +.04em. Inset the panel 48px from the edges.

P1 world labels 'packing floor', 'the forge', 'the seal 0%': One label style: 16px f-cond 600, +.04em, --tx-1, on a --scrim chip with a 2px outline. Colour only a 3px tick by meaning. Remove the letter-spacing on 'packing floor'.

P1 bottom-left hotbar and 'hp 100': Set the hp bar to 12px tall in --ok on a --ui-panel track, with a 20px f-cond 700 number right-aligned. Use one 4px radius for slots and a --acc 2px border for the selected slot. Hide empty slots or show them at 40% with 14px numbers. Remove the ghost icons.

tags-pixel.verdict: The HUD is readable and mostly lower case, but the earlier panel, chip and column fixes were only partly applied, so it still reads as several unrelated widgets with tiny text, mixed fills and uneven edges.
findings: P1 current pillagers panel, top left: Set rows to 16px on a 24px pitch. Make the 'you' row 20px --tx-1 with a 3px --acc left bar. Dim dead rows to --tx-2 and delete the footer. Use an opaque --ui-panel fill, a 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius, 16px padding, and position it at x=24, y=24.

P1 contract banner, bottom left (y≈789): Cut the text to 'contract item nearby'. Use a 32px chip with --ui-panel fill, a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 16px --tx-1 text, with the glyph as the only colour. Place it at x=24.

P1 bottom-left stack: status chips, 'f1 controls', hp bar: Use one 32px chip style with 16px --tx-1 labels and a 1px --ui-line-hi border for the status chips and the f1 hint. Reduce the hp bar to 12px high with 'hp 100' at 20px above it. Put everything on a 24px left edge with an 8px gap between rows.

P1 right-edge markers: 'a 15m' chip and 'the long dock cache' label: Use one 32px chip per item with --ui-panel fill, a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 16px --tx-1 text. Put the arrow inside the chip as its only colour. Inset the chips 24px from the right edge and stack them with an 8px gap. Rename 'a 15m' to '15m'.

P2 top centre: clock, score, extract chip: Make one 200px column with the same --ui-panel fill and 4px radius: clock 32px, then score at 20px with a 16px --tx-2 label, then the extract chip at 16px with the same width. Use an 8px gap. Put the sun icon inside the clock panel.

tags-smooth.verdict: The HUD is readable and the ammo card and weapon slots are fairly clean, but the top-right bar has a text collision, the top-centre stack is ragged, and the panels still don't share one frame and edge margin.
findings: P0 top-right run info bar: Make the bar 280px wide and 40px tall, at 24px from the top and right edges. Use 16px f-cond 600 text with 16px padding and a 16px gap between items. Drop the 'run' label or give it its own 8px slot. Keep '$900' at 20px and put stash and bag in tx-2. Set the border to 1px --ui-line-hi, the radius to 4px and the fill to --ui-panel.

P1 top-left 'current pillagers' panel: Move the panel to x=24, y=24. Use 16px rows with 16px padding and a 24px row pitch. Delete the '0' and the footer. Replace 'dead' with a 16px --danger glyph. Use a --ui-panel fill, a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius.

P1 top-centre timer, score and extract stack: Use one 240px column centred on x=960 with 8px gaps. Give every box the same --ui-panel fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius. Keep 15:00 as the one 56px hero and set the score to 32px. Set 'extract 707m' to 16px tx-1 with a teal glyph only. Move the sun icon outside the column.

P1 bottom-left status chips and hp bar: Put the chips and bar in one column at x=24, 8px apart, with a 24px bottom margin. Make the chips 16px tx-1 on --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Make 'hp 100' f-cond 800 at 32px, using --ui-panel for the track and 4px for the radius. Use --ok for the fill.

P1 weapon slots 1-8/0: Draw all nine slots at 72px wide and 72px tall with an 8px gap. Use the same --ui-panel fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius. Dim empty slots to 40 percent inside the same frame. Use a 2px --acc border on the selected slot only. Make the numerals 16px tx-2. Align the row's baseline with the ammo card at y=1056.

p1-idle.verdict: The run-info clutter, the right-edge extract pill and the open controls list are gone, but the HUD still looks like loose, undersized, inconsistent boxes sitting in the corners with no shared margin, type scale or panel style.
findings: P1 top-right goals panel (x1603-1901, y18-243): Show only the 3 active goals at 16px, with the labels in --tx-2 and the content in --tx-1. Use 32px row height with 1px --ui-line dividers. Put sp rewards right-aligned in tabular numerals. Collapse the rest behind the chevron by default. Inset the panel to the 96px / 48px margin. Use 16px padding and a 4px radius.

P1 top-centre stack: timer 9:59, score box, extract 170m, hold e to breach (x860-1160, y18-215): Make the timer the single 56px hero with the score as a 20px line beneath it, in one 240px-wide panel. Move the extract banner to its own row 16px below, on the same centre axis. Move the 'hold e to breach' prompt to 48px above the player so it no longer collides with the pillager tag.

P1 hotbar (x553-1465, y955-1055): Draw all 10 slots at 64px with 8px gaps, a --ui-panel fill, a 1px --ui-line border and a 4px radius. Put the number at 16px in --tx-2. Make the selected slot a 3px --acc top bar. Dim empty slots to 40% opacity. Centre the bar at x=960.

P1 bottom-left hp bar (x24-430, y1035-1070) and 'f1 controls' chip (x437-537, y928-952): Put hp in a 64px-high --ui-panel bar at x=96, y=968 with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Set the 'hp 100' label to 20px f-cond 600 and keep the green fill (--ok) to 8px high. Dock 'f1 controls' on the same left edge at 16px --tx-2, 8px above the bar.

P2 top-left scoreboard (x8-367, y143-242): Move it to x=96, y=48. Use 16px text, 32px rows, 1px --ui-line dividers and 16px padding. Give 'you' a 3px amber left bar and a --ui-raised fill. Align the '$' values right in tabular numerals. Move the 'keyboard' chip into the same 96px margin or drop it.

p1-progress.verdict: The controls list now folds to one line, the edge marker is gone and the clutter is down, but the HUD is still a pile of mismatched boxes with tiny text, and the unfinished hotbar and weak alert hierarchy keep it at a 3.
findings: P1 Hotbar, bottom centre (x 555-1465, y 955-1055): Draw all 9 slots as 56px cells with --ui-panel at 90% and a 1px --ui-line border at 4px radius. Put the number at 16px in --tx-2 inside each cell. Dim empty cells to 50% opacity. Keep the lime border on the selected slot only (it is amber now, so change it to --acc). Space the cells 8px apart.

P1 Top-right goals panel (x 1603-1900, y 18-243): Make the header 20px --tx-1 and the section labels 16px --tx-2. Set the items at 16px --tx-1 with the reward right-aligned in --tx-2 and a 28px row pitch. Move 'dawn clear' into the timer cluster. Use 24px padding, a --ui-line divider between sections, and a 3px --acc bar at the left of the header only.

P1 Top-centre cluster: timer, score, extract, breaching (x 860-1160, y 18-225): Use one panel style for the timer and score, with 16px between them. Move the extract chip to the same 20px style, centred 16px below the score. Move the breach readout to a 20px --warn label, anchored 24px above the ring and not over the sprites. Hide the 'pillager' nameplate while the breach label shows.

P1 Ammo card, bottom-right (x 1668-1910, y 902-1052): Set every HUD panel to a 24px inset from the screen edge (5% margin is the guide, 48px at minimum for safe areas). Move the card in so its right and bottom edges are 24px from the edge. Raise 'b / i backpack' to 16px --tx-2.

P2 Top-left pillagers panel (x 8-367, y 143-242) and 'keyboard' chip (x 10-105, y 8-30): Use a 24px inset, 16px text and a 28px row pitch. Give your own row --tx-1 plus a 3px amber (P1) left bar, and make the other rows --tx-2. Right-align the $ amounts in a tabular face. Restyle the chip with the shared panel fill and 16px --tx-2 text.

p2-idle.verdict: The controls list is now folded to one line and the disconnect banner and right-edge marker are gone, but the hud still has too many separately boxed readouts of different sizes with no shared margin or hierarchy.
findings: P1 top-right goals panel (x1603-1901, y20-243): Collapse it to a header row ('goals 0/3') plus the 3 active goals at 16px --tx-1. Render section labels at 14px --tx-2. Move the rest behind the chevron, folded by default. Inset the panel 48px from the top and right edges.

P1 hp bar, bottom-left (x24-430, y1035-1068): Make the bar 360x24 on a --ui-panel track with a 1px --ui-line border and an --ok fill. Put 'hp' at 16px --tx-2 and '100' at 20px --tx-1 above it or to its left, not on the fill. Inset it 48px from the left and bottom edges.

P1 stacked top-centre group: timer (x891-1029), score (x861-1059, y97-187), extract chip (y196-222), party toast (x885-1035, y893-930): Use one top-centre column centred on x=960 with 8px gaps: the timer (hero 56px), then one 480px score and extract strip at 20px. Fix the toast at y=860, centred, 20px on --ui-panel. Give all of them the same 4px radius and a 1px --ui-line border.
P2 hotbar (x553-1500, y955-1060): Draw all ten slots as 64x64 --ui-panel tiles with a 1px --ui-line border, with numbers at 14px --tx-2. Give the selected slot a 2px --acc border.
P2 'f1 controls' chip (x435-538, y928-952): Set the chip at x=48, y=972 in 16px --tx-2, aligned to the same left edge as the hp bar. Use a --ui-panel fill with a 1px --ui-line border and 8px padding.

p2-progress.verdict: This is an in-raid HUD, not the p2-progress menu I reviewed before, so none of the earlier advice (wordmark, player 2 button, saves block) was applied or could be checked. As a HUD it is a cluster of small, unevenly sized dark boxes: the timer, score and breach label overlap, the corner margins are far below 5%, and the text is cramped and hard to read.
findings: P0 Top-centre cluster: timer 9:59, score box, 'breaching 42%' label, 'extract 170m' chip, 'pillager' tag: Move the score into the left feed or the top-right list. Keep only the timer at top centre (56px hero). Place the breach label 24px above the progress ring, centred on it, with a --ui-panel fill and 8px padding so it clears the pillager tag. Allow 16px minimum between any two HUD boxes.

P1 Top-right goals panel (x1603-1901, y18-243): Use 20px --tx-1 for task names and 16px --tx-2 for labels. Put the rewards right-aligned in --acc or --tx-2 in a column. Add a 1px --ui-line divider between 'contracts' and 'run goals', and 16px padding. Fold the section down to the open goals only, and fix the l/I glyph ambiguity (use a font with a slashed or serif I, or check that the string says 'air strike').

P1 Left 'current pillagers 3 / value at risk' panel and the 'pillager' bar below it: Use one panel style for all three side panels: --ui-panel fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius. Set the rows at 16px with 24px height and make the rows for other players --tx-2. Shade the player's own row (you) with --acc text, or put an amber (P1) / cyan (P2) 3px bar on the left of the row.

P1 Bottom edge: hp bar (x24-430, y1035-1068), hotbar, 'fl controls' chip: Lift the hp bar to y≥1026 (54px from the bottom), height 24px, with a 1px dark border. Put 'hp' at 16px --tx-2 on the left and '100' at 20px in the bar. Give hotbar slots a --ui-panel fill and numbers in 16px --tx-1. Write the key as 'f1' in a 1px-bordered chip, aligned to the hotbar's left edge.

P2 'in pillager's party' tooltip at bottom centre (x885-1035, y893-928): Delete it, or show 'party' as a 16px --tx-2 tag on the player's name row in the left panel. If it stays, 16px text, 4px radius, 24px above the hotbar.

p1-x1.verdict: The HUD is readable, but it is still a scatter of mismatched boxes with no shared panel treatment. The earlier fixes were mostly not applied, and capitals remain on screen.
findings: P0 top-right 'run info' bar: Change the label to 'run info'. Make it a 160px --ui-panel chip with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius at 16px. Set it 48px from the right edge. Move the 'the long dock cache' tag to the top-left.

P0 'fl controls' hint at x≈440,y≈940 and 'c 152m' tag at right (y≈485): Dock the hint at x=48 just above the hp bar, written 'f1 controls' at 16px tx-2 inside a --ui-panel chip. Delete the 'c 152m' tag, or fold it into the top-centre extract banner.
P1 hp bar, bottom-left (y≈1050): Use a 20px 'hp 100' label with a 12px bar on --ui-raised, inset 48px from the left and bottom edges. Remove the 'pillager' bar at y≈335.

P1 top-left roster 'current pillagers 3': Collapse the roster to the player's own row by default. Use a 24px row pitch, 16px text and 16px padding, with names in tx-2 and values in tx-1. Give it a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Give the 'keyboard' tag the same chip style.

P1 'active reload x1' chip (left, y≈452): Move it to x=48 directly above the weapon slots. Use a 40px icon, a 20px f-cond 600 title and a 16px tx-2 detail on --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Keep lime on the ring only.

p1-x3.verdict: The raid HUD is still a patchwork of unrelated chip styles: only the hp bar and the reload chip were partly fixed, and 'run Info' keeps its capital letter, the duplicate 'c 152m' chip and the loose, unaligned top-left cluster.
findings: P1 top-right 'run Info' bar (x~1610,y~32): Render it as 'run info'. Make it a 40px-high card with a --ui-panel fill, a 1px --ui-line-hi border, a 4px radius, 16px f-cond text and 8px padding. Set its right edge at 48px from the screen edge and keep the chevron inside the padding.

P1 'c 152m' chip with arrow (right, y~485) and 'extract 152m' (top centre): Delete the 'c 152m' chip and keep only the edge arrow, with no label. Keep 'extract 152m' as the single readout in a teal 16px chip with a 4px radius. Remove the arrow tucked under the chip, or make it 16px and centred.

P1 hp bar (bottom left, y~1050): Move the bar to x=48 and bottom=48. Make it 24px tall on a --ui-panel track with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Put '100' inside it at 20px f-cond 700 and a 'hp' label at 16px tx-2. Align the two status icons to the bar's left edge, 8px above it.

P1 top-left 'current pillagers' list and 'pillager' bar (x~10-370,y~145-360): Give both the same panel style: --ui-panel fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius, 8px padding. Set the left edge to x=48. Use 16px labels, 20px values and a 24px row pitch. Show only the 'you' row by default and collapse the rest behind the chevron. Stack the 'pillager' bar 8px below the list.

P1 active reload chip (left, y~452): Dock the chip at x=48, 8px above the hp bar. Use a --ui-panel fill, a 1px --ui-line-hi border, a 4px radius and a 3px --acc bar on the left edge. Set the title to 20px f-cond 600 tx-1 and the sub-line to 16px tx-2. Change the ring from teal to --acc.

p2-x1.verdict: The reload chip is better, but the run-info bar, hp bar, world tag and party tooltip are unchanged, and the screen is cluttered with floating tags and panels that don't match each other.
findings: P0 top-right 'run Info' dropdown, x1603-1900, y18-55: Change the label to 'run info'. Make it 200x40px with --ui-panel fill, a 1px --ui-line-hi border, a 4px radius and 16px f-cond 600 text. Make the chevron 16px in tx-2.

P1 bottom-left hp bar, x24-430, y1035-1068: Make the bar 320x24px and put its bottom edge 16px above the screen bottom (y1040), with its left edge at x16 to match the other panels. Use 20px f-cond 600 text in tx-1 on a --ui-panel track with a 1px --ui-line border. Use --ok at full health and --danger below 30%.

P1 in-world tag 'pillager' above the player, x358-404, y463-483, plus the left card at y323-358: Delete the world tag. Keep the card, with a 3px P2 cyan left bar, 16px tx-1 text, a 4px radius and a --ui-panel fill. Align its left edge to x16.
P1 bottom-centre 'in pillager's party' tooltip, x884-1036, y893-929: Delete it. If the party tag is needed, add it as a 16px tx-2 line inside the player card.

P1 left column stack: pillagers list y143-242, card y323-358, reload chip y430-475: Put all three on x16 with 8px gaps between them. Give them the same --ui-panel fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius and 8px inner padding. Keep the reload chip's lime ring only while the buff is active.

p2-x3.verdict: The HUD is still a set of unrelated boxes: a capital 'I' in 'run Info', an hp bar stuck to the bottom-left corner, a clipped hotbar and chips with mismatched padding, borders and type sizes. Almost none of the earlier advice has been applied.
findings: P0 top-right 'run Info' dropdown: Change the text to 'run info'. Make the bar 200x40, right edge at x=1824, with a --ui-panel fill, a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Use 16px f-cond 600 text and a 12px chevron in tx-2.

P1 bottom hotbar slots 1-10: Draw all 10 slots as 64px --ui-panel squares with a 1px --ui-line border and 8px gaps, centred at the bottom with 48px from the bottom edge. Give the selected slot a 2px --acc border. Use 16px f-cond numerals in tx-2 at the top-left of each slot. Dim empty slots to 50%.

P1 bottom-left 'hp 100' bar: Inset it 48px from the left and bottom edges. Put a 32px f-cond 700 number to the left of a 320x16 bar with a --ui-panel track, a 1px --ui-line-hi border and an --ok fill. Use the 16px label 'hp' in tx-2 and keep the number off the fill. Make the 'pillager' bar the same component.

P1 top-left 'current pillagers' panel and the 'pillager' bar below it: Set the panel to x=96, 300px wide, with 16px padding and a 28px row pitch. Use 16px tx-2 labels and 20px tx-1 values. Fill the 'you' row with --ui-raised and add a 3px amber bar at its left. Dock the pillager bar 8px under the panel at the same left edge and the same width.

P1 left 'active reload x3' chip: Dock it 8px under the pillager bar at the same x and width. Use a 20px title and a 16px tx-2 sub-line on --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Set the ring stroke to --acc and make the icon 32px.

p1-view-p1.verdict: The in-raid HUD is functional but scattered: it uses several panel styles, mixed type sizes and a capital letter, the hp bar dominates the screen, and the small corner widgets are hard to read.
findings: P1 top-right 'run info' bar: Render 'run info' fully lower case. Restyle the bar as --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius, and drop its width from about 300px to about 200px. Give the cache tag 16px of clearance from the bar.

P1 bottom-left hp bar ('hp 100'): Reduce the bar to about 240px by 20px. Set the hp number in 20px f-cond. Use --ok for the fill with a --ui-panel track. Align its left edge to the 5% margin (96px) and its baseline to the weapon-slot row.

P1 top-left 'current pillagers' panel: Use 16px type with --tx-2 for the header and --tx-1 for rows. Mark the 'you' row with an amber 3px left bar and a --ui-raised fill. Match the border and radius of the ammo panel (1px --ui-line-hi, 4px). Add 8px row padding.

P1 bottom-right ammo block: Raise 'b / i backpack' to 16px in --tx-2. Left-align both text lines to the same inset (16px). Keep the 56px hero number. Move the panel to the 5% margin, about 48px from the bottom and right edges.

P2 weapon slot row (1–0): Set the selected border to --acc, 2px. Make slot numerals 16px at --tx-2 or brighter. Remove the ghost icons, or dim the empty slots to 30% opacity on a --ui-panel fill. Move the toast to the left feed zone.

p1-view-p2.verdict: The in-raid HUD has the right pieces but they are scattered, use mismatched type sizes, and the left side is crowded. Several panels fight for attention, the ammo number is the only clear hero, and the hp bar is oversized and clipped at the bottom-left.
findings: P1 bottom-left hp bar: Inset it to 5% margins (48px from the left, 32px from the bottom). Reduce it to 14px tall inside a 4px-radius --ui-panel box with a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Show 'hp 100' at 20px f-cond 600 in --tx-1, and use --ok for the fill.

P1 left column: 'current pillagers' list, 'pillager' bar, 'active reload x2' chip: Stack them in one 8px-grid column at x=48 with a shared width (about 320px), 8px gaps, and --ui-panel fill with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius. Set the list rows to 16px minimum with 8px row padding. Give the 'pillager' bar the same panel as the others.

P1 hierarchy overall: Keep one hero (ammo) at --fs-hero. Drop the timer to 32px. Make the party toast and controls chip --tx-2 at 16px with no border so they recede. Give the active reload chip a 16px label and no glow.

P1 top-right 'run info' dropdown and 'the long dock cache' label: Shrink 'run info' to a fit-content pill, 40px tall, with 16px text in the shared panel style. Attach the location name as a second line inside the same panel, or move it into the top-centre banner. Align the right edge to x=1872 (48px margin).

P2 bottom-centre quick slots: Draw all ten slots as 64px cells with --ui-panel fill and a 1px --ui-line border. Use a 2px --acc border for the selected slot only, 16px --tx-2 numerals inside the cell, and the same ammo count position in every filled cell.

p2-view-p1.verdict: The raid HUD has working pieces, but it is scattered and its type sizes, panel styles and colours are inconsistent. Several lines compete with each other, and the lower-left and top-right corners look unresolved.
findings: P1 whole HUD, panel language: Use one panel: #16191b fill, 1px #4a5257 border, 4px radius, 8px padding. Apply it to the pillagers list, run info, active reload, toast, ammo and controls chip. Drop the extra white and teal outlines.

P1 top-left 'current pillagers' list: Set rows to 20px f-cond 600 with a 32px row height and 1px #2e3337 dividers. Set the header to 16px tx-2. Add 16px padding. Give 'you' an amber (P1) tag or bar. Show only the other pillagers' $ value in tx-1.

P1 duplicate and redundant messages: Cut the 'gold glow marks the box' explanation to 'contract item nearby'. Remove the duplicate 'c 152m' marker or turn it into a bare arrow. Merge the hints into the single f1 controls line at the mid-bottom left, set at 16px with the pad focus style. Remove 'b / i backpack' or set it at 14px in the card footer.

P1 hp bar, bottom-left: Put hp in a panel at the 5% safe margin (54px left, 54px bottom). Use a 12px tall bar and a 32px number with an 'hp' label at 16px. Align it with the weapon slots. Label or group the two status icons into one 40px chip row. Remove the second HP plate or fold it into the list.

P1 weapon slots, bottom-centre: Use a uniform 96x96 slot with a 4px radius and the panel fill. Draw the selected slot with a 2px #e6ff3d border. Set the key number at 16px tx-2 in the same top-left corner for every slot. Hide empty slots or draw them at 30% opacity inside their own panel. Set ammo at 16px bold.

p2-view-p2.verdict: The in-raid HUD reads clearly and keeps to lower case, but it is a pile of mismatched widgets: five different panel styles, four competing readouts in the bottom-left, and no clear hero element.
findings: P1 bottom-left hp bar: Rebuild it as a 16px-tall bar with a 1px --ui-line-hi border on a --ui-panel fill, using --ok for the fill. Put the hp value at 20px f-cond 700, inset 24px from the left and bottom. Keep it clear of the slot row, with at least 16px between them.

P1 ammo card, bottom-right: Set the number to --fs-hero 56px f-cond 800, with '/ 50' at 32px in --tx-2 on the same baseline. Right-align every line in the card. Add a 3px --acc underline or low-ammo state. Inset the card 48px from the edges.

P1 top-left 'current pillagers' list, 'pillager' bar and top-right 'run info': Give all three the same chrome: --ui-panel at 90% alpha, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius, 16px padding. Set row text at 16px minimum. Put 'value at risk' in --tx-2. Make the list's row height 24px, and align the three panels to one 48px left or right margin.

P2 weapon slot bar: Draw all 10 slots as 56px tiles on --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line border. Draw the selected tile with a 2px --acc border, not amber. Set the ammo count at 16px f-cond 600 and the key hints at 14px.

P2 top-centre timer, extract chip and compass: Put the timer on a --ui-panel plate at 32px f-cond 700. Show the extract distance once, either in the teal chip or the edge arrow. Tie the cache label to its object or remove it.

p1-cap.verdict: The earlier clutter fixes (ghost hotbar icons, the extra left widgets and the name plate) are mostly in, but a blocking 'want easy mode?' modal now sits mid-screen with an oversized lime slab and a lone unlabeled '9', and the HUD around it is still crowded and uneven.
findings: P1 'want easy mode?' modal (492-1427 x 261-579): Add a --scrim rgba(6,7,8,.80) full-screen layer behind the card. Shrink the card to about 640x300 and centre it at y=540, so it clears the HUD. Put the '9' in a 56px --fs-hero style or a 40px countdown ring, or fold it into the 'no' button as 'n no 9'. Set the title to 32px with 32px padding.

P1 'y yes' button (539-944 x 432-532): Make both buttons 56px tall. Keep lime on only the focused button, and give the other button a 1px --ui-line-hi border with --tx-1 text. Put 'y' and 'n' in 16px key-caps with a 4px radius. Set the labels to 20px f-cond 700 and centre them with 16px between the buttons.

P1 top-centre stack: clock, 'team score', 'extract 141m' (825-1094 x 18-258): Merge the clock and score into one 268px panel with 8px/16px padding. Show the team total at 20px, with the per-player values as 16px --tx-2 text. Put 'extract 141m' at 16px teal with 16px of clearance above the modal. Align the menu button to the 32px right edge or the top-right cluster.

P1 bottom hotbar and bottom-left bars (24-430 x 965-1068, slots 560-1460): Make both bars 12px tall and 320px wide at x=32. Put the labels above at 16px, with hp value 20px. Remove the empty numerals 2-5 and 7-0 and show one dimmed spare slot. Put 'f1 controls' at 16px, 32px above the hotbar's left edge.

P1 left widgets: 'player 2' plate (16-170 x 322-358), 'active reload x3' chip (8-263 x 430-486), 'keyboard' and 'elite cache' tags (top-left): Put all of them on one --ui-panel at 80% fill with a 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius, and x=32. Use 16px gaps. Set the labels to 16px, the 'active reload' title to 20px f-cond 600 and the '+15% damage' line to 16px --tx-2. Set 'keyboard' in f-cond 600 like the rest.

p2-cap.verdict: The 'want easy mode?' modal is a plain flat rectangle in the middle of a busy HUD, with a huge empty header band, a lime 'yes' that takes the choice for the player, and cramped, unaligned HUD modules around it.
findings: P1 'want easy mode?' modal (x=492-1427, y=260-579): Draw a --scrim rgba(6,7,8,.80) over the whole screen. Make the card 720x360 with a --ui-panel fill, a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius, centred. Use 32px padding, a 32px --tx-1 title at y+32, and cut the dead gap so the buttons sit 24px under the title. Turn the countdown into a full-width 4px --acc bar along the card's bottom edge that drains, and keep the '9' at 20px --tx-2 beside the title.

P1 'y yes' / 'n no' buttons (y=432-533): Make both buttons 56px high and 280px wide with 16px between them, centred, 4px radius. Keep 'yes' as the --acc fill with --acc-ink 20px text, and give 'no' a 1px --ui-line-hi border with --tx-1 text. Show 'y' and 'n' as 16px --tx-2 key chips on the left of each button. Put pad focus on a 3px --acc outline with a 4px offset.

P1 left column: 'player 1' bar, 'active reload x3' card, 'armour 60', 'hp 100': Stack them in one column at x=48, 360px wide, with 16px gaps and one panel recipe (--ui-panel fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius, 16px padding). Keep one health bar, 24px high, with --ok fill and a 20px --tx-1 'hp 100' label. Put the 'armour 60' bar directly above it at 16px high. Make 'player 1' a 16px --tx-2 label, not a second bar. Make the buff card 64px high, with its text at 20px/16px.

P1 top-centre cluster: '9:58' clock, storm icon, 'team score' panel, 'extract 118m' pill: Make one 280px panel centred at x=820-1100. Put the clock at 32px --tx-1 in the top row, a 16px --tx-2 'team score 0 sp' row below it, and the 'you / p1' split on one row at 16px with 16px padding. Leave a 16px gap, then a 32px-high extract pill with 16px --extract text. Dock the storm icon inside the panel at its right, 24px.

P1 hotbar (y=955-1055): Draw all 10 slots as 64px tiles with 8px gaps, centred at the bottom with a 48px margin. Give empty slots a 1px --ui-line border at 40% opacity and a 16px --tx-2 number. Make the selected slot a 3px --acc outline. Keep the ammo count at 16px inside the tile.

p1-15.verdict: The hud reads clearly and the ammo hero is strong, but the left side is crowded, the kill feed repeats itself, and the earlier hp, hotbar, extract-chip and f1 fixes are only partly applied.
findings: P1 left column: pillagers panel, 'pillager' bar, three buff cards, three damage lines: Give every left-edge block one shared width (~220px), one --ui-panel fill at 85% alpha, --rad 4px and 8px padding. Use 20px f-cond 600 for titles and 16px for sub-lines. Put 16px gaps between blocks. Drop the plate behind the 'pillager' mini bar, or merge it into the pillagers panel.

P1 kill feed, right edge (3x 'pillager killed crawler' + 'you killed crawler'): Collapse repeats into 'pillager killed crawler x3'. Show kills in one place only, either the feed or the damage lines. Use 16px tx-2 on a 60% alpha plate, with only 'you' lines in tx-1 and no lime.

P1 hp bar, bottom-left: Make the bar 14px high on a --ui-panel plate with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a --ok fill. Put 'hp 97' at 20px f-cond 600 tx-1 above the bar, left-aligned. Inset the bar to x=48 (5% margin) and align it with the hotbar baseline.

P1 hotbar, bottom-centre: Draw empty slots as 72px tiles at 60% alpha with a 1px --ui-line border and the digit at 16px tx-2 in the top-left corner. Drop the ghost icons. Use a 3px --acc border on the selected slot (or keep the P1 amber ring and add an --acc corner pip).

P2 top-right 'run info' card: Use a 16px tx-2 label per section with 20px tx-1 values. Set a 16px left inset and a 1px --ui-line divider between 'dawn clear' and 'contracts'. Shrink the card width to its content plus 16px padding.

p1-3.verdict: The hud reads clearly, but it is still a pile of mismatched boxes: the two top panels differ in width, the left-edge stack has no common margin, and the empty-slot ghosts and tiny text keep it short of polished.
findings: P1 top-left 'current pillagers' panel vs top-right 'run info' panel: Give both the same --ui-panel fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius and 16px padding, at 360px wide, pinned to the 48px margins and top-aligned at y=48. Set row text to 16px minimum with 8px row gaps, and make the chevron 16px.

P1 hotbar, empty slots 3 and 5-0 and the ghost weapon silhouettes: Delete the ghost icons and show only slots 1-4 plus at most one empty slot, all 96px square. Put the selected slot in a 2px --acc border and the others in 1px --ui-line-hi on --ui-panel. Set slot numbers to 16px tx-2 inside a --ui-panel pill at the top-left.

P1 left edge stack: buff cards, kill/feed lines, status icons, hp: Pin everything to x=48. Buff chips are 40px high with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 16px tx-1 text. Feed lines are 16px tx-1 on --ui-panel, with a 3px bar in the player colour only. Space the groups 24px apart.
P1 hp bar bottom-left: Put hp in a --ui-panel frame at x=48, bottom 48px. The bar is 360x12 in --ok #76b97c. The number is 32px f-cond 700 tx-1 with no outline, and a 16px 'hp' label sits above it.

P2 right column pickup stack and 'c 152m' marker: Collapse repeats into one row, 'pillager killed crawler x4', at 16px. Pin the column at the 48px right margin with 8px gaps. Put the 'c 152m' marker with the extract indicator at the top.

p2-15.verdict: The ammo card and buff stack are readable, but the HUD still has no single panel style, the hp bar and hotbar are unchanged, and the banner sits in the middle of the playfield.
findings: P1 hp bar, bottom-left: Make the bar 280x16 with a 1px --ui-line-hi border on a --ui-panel track. Fill it with --ok. Put 'hp 100' at 20px in --tx-1 above the bar. Inset it to 96px left and 54px bottom.

P1 hotbar slots 3 to 0, bottom centre: Draw slots 3 to 0 as 64px --ui-panel tiles at 50% opacity with a 1px --ui-line border. Put the numbers inside each tile at 16px --tx-2. Mark the selected slot with a 3px --acc bar and a 2px --acc outline.

P1 left column: 'current pillagers' panel, buff cards, kill feed, 'f1 controls' chip: Put every left widget on one panel recipe: --ui-panel at 88% opacity, 4px radius, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 16px padding. Align them all to x=96 with a 16px gap. Use 16px --tx-2 for sub-lines and 20px --tx-1 for names.

P1 'host disconnected / you are hosting now' banner: Anchor it at top-centre, y=96, with 24px clear of the extract pill. Use a --ui-panel fill at 92% with a 4px --danger left bar and no outline. Set the title at 32px in --tx-1 with a --danger icon, and the sub-line at 16px in --tx-2.

P1 extract markers: 'extract 146m' pill under the clock and 'c 146m' with an arrow at the right edge: Keep the edge compass arrow only. Label it 'extract 146m' at 16px in --extract on a --ui-panel tile. Delete the top pill and its small arrow, so the clock stands alone.

p2-4.verdict: The old disconnect banner is gone and the weapon block is a clear hero number, but the HUD still has about eight panel styles, four text sizes of the same row, and a hp bar and pillager list that ignore the earlier advice.
findings: P0 bottom-left 'hp 100' bar: Inset the bar 48px from the left and bottom edges. Make it 16px tall with a 4px radius and a --ui-line track. Put 'hp 100' at 20px --tx-1 above or beside it, not inside it. Keep the --ok fill and switch it to --danger below 30%.

P1 top-left 'current pillagers' list: Set the text to 16px and the rows to 24px, inside a --ui-panel box with 8px padding and a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Colour 'you' in --warn or amber for P1. Move the panel to x=96, y=96. Put 8px of space between the chevron and the header text.

P1 left column: 'pillager' bar, three buff cards, three kill-feed rows: Put every left-side element on the same x of 48px, with a single panel style (--ui-panel, 1px --ui-line-hi, 4px radius) and an 8px gap between rows. Stack buffs, then feed, with no 250px dead gap. Give the teammate bar a label at 16px.

P1 right-edge 'you killed crawler' x4: Remove the right-side kill lines (kills belong to the left feed only). Keep the right stack for pickups, set in --tx-1 at 16px on a --ui-panel row with a 3px rarity bar. Merge repeats into 'crawler x4'.

P1 top-right 'run info' dropdown, 'the long dock cache' tag, 'c 146m' tag: Use one chip style (--ui-panel, 1px --ui-line-hi, 4px radius, 16px --tx-1, 40px rows). Right-align all three at x=1824. Fold 'c 146m' into the 'run info' content. Hold the dropdown closed by default.

rifle-switch-host.verdict: This is a readable raid HUD with a strong ammo hero number. It has a stray capital in 'run Info', two crowded panels in the left column, undersized text and near-invisible empty weapon slots.
findings: P1 top-right 'run info' dropdown: Render it as 'run info'. Shrink the bar to about 200px wide and 40px tall on --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line-hi border, and sit it on the 48px margin.

P1 mid-left controls list (move/fight/gear/raid): Fold it to a single 16px line, 'f1 controls', at mid-bottom left (per rs-1). If the party demo must keep it open, cut it to one column of 8 rows, set every label to 16px tx-2, and put it on a 48px left margin with the same panel fill as the roster.

P1 top-left 'current pillagers' roster: Use 16px labels on a 24px row pitch. Give the 'you' row a --ui-raised fill with a 3px amber (P1) left bar. Right-align the $ values in f-cond. Drop 'dead' into a --danger glyph. Put the panel on the 48px margin.

P1 bottom weapon bar slots 4-0: Draw all 10 slots as 64px tiles at an 8px gap, with a 1px --ui-line border. Show empty ones as flat --ui-panel with the number at 16px in tx-2 and no silhouette. Make only the selected slot 80px with a lime 2px border. Keep amber for P1 identity elsewhere.

P2 bottom-left hp bar: Set 'hp' at 16px label and '100' at 32px in tx-1 on a --ui-panel plate. Use a 12px bar in --ok. Place it on the 48px bottom-left margin. Reserve the 56px hero size for the ammo only.

01-ads-hip-player1.verdict: The HUD parts are readable, but they still sit at different insets and sizes with no shared grid. The hp bar is cramped into the corner, the selected slot is amber (not lime) and has an empty icon, and the ghost slots 4-0 are barely legible.
findings: P1 hp bar, bottom-left (x24-430, y1035-1068): Inset it to 48px from the left and 40px from the bottom. Make it 24px tall with a --ui-panel track and a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Set the 'hp' label to 16px --tx-2 and the number to 20px f-cond 700 --tx-1, placed above the bar or inside it with 8px padding. Reserve the 56px hero size for the ammo count only.
P1 weapon slot 2, selected (x666-768, y957-1059): Use a 2px --acc #e6ff3d border and a --ui-raised #1e2225 fill. Draw the icon at 100% opacity in --tx-1 (it is dim now). Draw idle slots at 60%.

P1 ghost slots 4-0 (x890-1520, y960-1030): Either hide slots 4-0 until the weapons are owned, or give each a 4px-radius --ui-panel frame at 40% opacity, 100x100 like slots 1-3, with 16px --tx-2 digits. Match the 8px gap.

P1 top-left chip 'current pillagers 0' and top-right 'run info' (x8-367 y143-168, x1603-1900 y20-54): Make both chips 36px high, 4px radius, --ui-panel fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 16px f-cond 600 text. Anchor both at a 48px inset from their edges and make them the same width (about 320px). Align them to the same row, y=48.

P1 ammo card, bottom-right (x1668-1910, y903-1052): Inset the card to 48px right and 40px bottom. Set '/ 60' to 32px --tx-2 at weight 600, keep the 56px 800 hero '25' in --tx-1, and left-align 'auto rifle' and the hint to the same edge at 16px --tx-2.

02-ads-unscoped-player1.verdict: The ads view still looks like unfinished debug UI: a pale wedge washes out the scene, the hud sits in several different styles, and the ammo panel, hp bar and hotbar are the same as in my last review.
findings: P0 bottom-left hp bar 'hp 100': Make the bar 280x8px at 24px from the left and bottom edges. Use a --ui-panel track with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and an --ok fill, switching to --danger below 30%. Put 'hp' at 16px --tx-2 above the bar and '100' at 20px f-cond 600 --tx-1.

P0 centre, pale wedge and circle aim overlay: Cut the wedge fill to about 10% alpha and give it a 1px --tx-1 edge at 30%. Cap it at the weapon range. Dim the area outside it with a --scrim at 30%. Remove the circle, or draw it as a 1px ring.

P1 bottom-right ammo panel: Make the panel opaque (--ui-panel at 94%) with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius. Set the name to 16px --tx-2 and show 'ads' as a separate 16px tag. Show '12' at 56px in --acc and '/ 60' at 32px --tx-2. Make the hint 16px --tx-2 and drop 'backpack' from it. Keep 24px from the edges.

P1 hotbar, slots 1-3 and empty 4-0: Give all 10 slots an 80x80px --ui-panel cell with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius. Draw empty slots at 40% opacity in the same cell. Mark the selected slot with a 2px --acc border and a 3px --acc bar, not amber. Set the numbers and counts to 16px f-cond 600 --tx-2. Keep a 8px gap between cells.

P1 world labels: 'the seal 0%', 'the forge', 'sentry r-46', 'packing floor': Use one world-label style: 16px f-cond 600 --tx-1 on a --scrim plate at 80% with 4px radius and 8px padding. Use colour only for a 3px left bar. Keep labels at least 24px inside the viewport and flip them to the left of the object near an edge. Give the zone name 'packing floor' the same plate.

03-ads-4x-player1.verdict: The scope view reads clearly, but the earlier fixes for the HUD margins, vignette and reticle were mostly not applied, and the corner widgets still look like unstyled browser dropdowns.
findings: P1 top-left 'current pillagers 0' dropdown (8,142 to 368,170) and top-right 'run info' (1602,18 to 1900,54): Make both 36px tall with a #16191b fill, a 1px #4a5257 border and a 4px radius. Put them at x=48 and right edge x=1872, with the same top y=48. Set the label to 16px tx-2 and the count to 20px tx-1. Make the chevron 12px in tx-2. Hide the pillagers bar while the count is 0. Cut the width to about 200px.
P1 whole view, ADS 4x state: Add a vignette of about 35% black, starting at 60% radius. Drop the laser to 40% opacity and 1px. Dim the light disc around the player by 30%.

P1 reticle (1196,512 to 1340,656): Draw a 2px #e6ff3d cross with a 24px gap and arms 12px long. Add a 1px ring at 60% opacity. Add a 1px black outline behind it, and a '4x' tag in 16px lime 16px to the right.

P2 bottom-right weapon card (1668,902 to 1910,1052): End the card at x=1872 and y=1032. Name the weapon at 20px tx-1 and move '4x' to a 16px lime tag in the top-right corner. Set the hint to 16px #aaa498. Use a 4px radius and a 1px #4a5257 border. Keep the 56px ammo number as the hero.

P2 hp bar bottom-left (24,1034 to 430,1068): Move it to x=48 and bottom 48px. Make it 16px tall with a #2e3337 track and a 4px radius, filled with --ok #76b97c. Put '100' at 20px f-cond 700 tx-1, right-aligned inside the bar.

04-ads-pad-player1.verdict: The hud is readable and fairly clean, but the earlier fixes were not applied: the hp bar still hugs the corner, the sentry label still clips the robot, the timer is still small and the left and right panels are mismatched.
findings: P1 hp bar, bottom-left (x24-430, y1035-1068): Inset it to 48px left and 48px bottom, and make it 360x24. Use a --ui-panel track with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and an --ok fill. Set the label to 20px f-cond 600, with the 'hp' word at 16px --tx-2 and the 100 at 20px --tx-1, with 16px left padding.

P1 sentry label (x1247-1409, y380-431): Use a --scrim chip with a 4px radius and 8px/16px padding, text at 20px f-cond 600 --tx-1. Anchor it 8px above the sprite's head (bottom edge near y360) so it doesn't touch the robot. Match the 'packing floor' label to the same style.

P1 top-centre timer (x905-1030, y10-95): Make 'extract 63m' 32px f-cond 800 --extract, with 9:00 at 20px --tx-2 above it. Remove the detached arrow, or attach it 8px below the chip as a 16px triangle. Give the chip an 8px pad and a 4px radius.

P1 ammo card, bottom-right (x1668-1910, y902-1052): Inset the card 48px from the right and bottom. Set the weapon name to 20px f-cond 600 --tx-2. Keep 5 / 60 at 56px 800. Set 'view backpack' to 16px --tx-2 with a key chip. Use a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 16px padding.

P2 hotbar (x555-1540, y957-1058): Give all slots a 72x72 --ui-panel cell with a 1px --ui-line border, and dim the empty ones to 40% opacity. Use a 2px --acc ring for the selected slot. Set the number labels to 16px --tx-2 and the 'rb' chip to 16px with 8px padding.

05-ads-2x-player2.verdict: Gameplay reads fine, but the HUD is still a mix of unrelated widgets: the previous edge, hotbar, hp and chip fixes were not applied, and a capital 'I' is still on screen.
findings: P0 top-right 'run Info' chip (x1603-1902, y18-55): Render 'run info' in lower case. Style it as a --ui-panel chip with a 4px radius, a 1px --ui-line-hi border, 16px f-cond --tx-1 text and a --tx-2 chevron. Inset it to a 48px margin.

P0 'the seal 0%' label (x1760-1892, y458-490): Use the same chip as the sentry tag at 16px f-cond: --scrim fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border, --tx-1 text. Give the '0%' --extract colour. Keep the chip at x <= 1872.

P1 hotbar (x555-1500, y955-1060): Draw all 10 slots as 88px tiles on an 8px gap. Give each a 1px --ui-line-hi border on --ui-panel at 80%, with empty slots at 40% opacity. Mark the selected slot with a 2px --acc border only. Put the digits at the top-left in 16px --tx-2. Lift the bar so its bottom edge is 48px from the screen bottom.

P1 hp bar, bottom-left (x24-430, y1035-1068): Place it at x 48 and bottom 48. Draw an 8px tall --ok bar on a --ui-line track. Put '100' at 32px f-cond 700 --tx-1 above it with 'hp' at 16px --tx-2. Turn the bar --danger below 30%.
P1 'current pillagers 0' chip (x8-367, y143-170): Use the same chip style as 'run info'. Inset it to x 48 and match its top and height (36px) to the 'run info' chip at y 48. Add 8px/16px padding.

06-ads-hip-player2.verdict: The reduced HUD mostly follows the style guide, but the panels still have inconsistent fills, borders and margins, the hp bar is still huge and the 'keyboard' tag is still too small.
findings: P1 hp bar, bottom-left (x24-430, y1035-1068): Make the bar 240x16px on a #16191b track with a 1px #4a5257 border. Set its left edge at x48 and its bottom edge at y1032. Put 'hp 100' above it at 20px f-cond 600 tx-1.
P1 ammo card, bottom-right (x1668-1910, y903-1052): Move the right edge to x1872 and the bottom to y1032. Set both labels to 16px tx-2 with 16px padding, and keep the 56px hero number.

P1 top-left and top-right panels: 'keyboard', 'current pillagers 0', 'run info': Give all three a #16191b fill, a 1px #4a5257 border, a 4px radius and 8/16px padding. Set their text to 16px f-cond 600 tx-1 and align them to x48 and y24. Make 'keyboard' a plain 16px tx-2 tag in the same panel style.

P1 top-centre clock and extract pill (x905-1030, y12-75): Set the clock to 40px f-cond 800 tx-1 over a #16191b panel. Set the pill to 16px tx-1 on #16191b with a 3px teal left bar, and delete the arrow.
P2 'f1 controls' hint (x440-540, y930-952): Use a #16191b panel with a 1px #4a5257 border, 16px text and an 8px key cap, at x48 and y984. Keep it clear of the hp bar.

timelord-controls.verdict: The controls list is still a full 440x770px slab of tiny text pinned to the top-left, so it hides the map and fights the HUD, and last round's advice to fold it to one line was not followed. The 'run info' bar, the stray 'info' capital and the duplicate 'c 152m' marker are also unfixed.
findings: P0 controls card, x15-450 y30-800: Fold the card to one 32px line, 'f1 controls', at x=48, y~960. When F1 opens it, anchor it bottom-left and cap it at 8 rows per group with a 2-column layout. Auto-close it after 5s.

P1 controls card, type and hierarchy: Set every row to 16px minimum, with the action at 20px tx-1 and the key cap at 16px f-cond in tx-2. Make headers 16px f-cond +.04em in tx-2 with a 1px --ui-line rule above each. Use a 16px gap between groups. Drop the lime-adjacent amber.
P1 controls card, panel and edge: Use --ui-panel fill, a 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius and 24px inner padding, inset 48px. Set 'f1 hide' to 16px tx-2 with a key cap.

P1 run info bar, top-right x1603-1900 y18-53: Change the text to 'run info' in all lower case. Use --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius. Set the chevron to 20px tx-1. Inset 48px from the right edge.

P1 top centre, extract pill x903-1017 y47-73, and 'c 152m' at x1805-1890 y476-496: Delete the 'c 152m' text and keep only the teal edge arrow. Set the pill to 20px with 8px vertical padding. Use --fs-hero 56px for the timer only when extract is under 60s.

timelord-settings.verdict: A clean, consistent full-screen settings card with a clear lime focus row, but the detail pane is mostly empty, the list mixes raid and audio rows under one tab, and row text is small and dim.
findings: P1 right detail pane: Show the current value and what each option does, or a preview. Otherwise narrow the pane to about 360px and give the list the freed width. Drop the lime top border unless the pane has focus.

P1 centre list, rows 'master volume' to 'effects volume': Move the volume rows under 'audio'. If the section has to stay, add a 16px label such as 'sound' in tx-2 with 24px spacing above it, and stop the list from being clipped mid-row at y=990.
P1 row labels and tab labels: Set row names to 20px in tx-1 (#efe9dc) at weight 600, or in tx-2 (#aaa498) at the very least. Set idle tab labels to 20px tx-2. Keep values in tx-1.

P2 left tab column: Give the active tab a --ui-raised fill and tx-1 text, and keep the lime bar only for the focused item. Use one 56px rhythm for tabs and rows. Group 'send play data' under a 1px divider.
P2 focused row 'timelord mode': Dim idle arrows to tx-2 at about 50% opacity. Keep lime only on the focused row's arrows and value, and remove the lime top border from the detail pane.

timelord-toggle.verdict: The controls card is now one folded line and the oversized left card is gone, but the HUD panels still don't share one recipe, the text is tiny, and the 'run info' label still has a capital I.
findings: P1 top-right 'run info' bar (x1603-1900, y18-54): Change the text to 'run info'. Use --ui-panel at 90% opacity, a 1px --ui-line-hi border, a 4px radius, 16px --f-cond 600 text and 16px padding. Shrink the bar to its content, about 200px wide, and keep the chevron inset 16px from the right.

P1 HUD panel recipe: pillagers card, run info bar, ammo card, timelord toast, contract toast, 'f1 controls' chip, 'the long dock cache' label, 'c 152m' chip: Put every HUD panel on --ui-panel at 90%, a 1px --ui-line-hi border, a 4px radius and 16px padding. Take all text from the 56/32/20/16/14 scale and nothing smaller than 14px. Restyle the two map chips as 16px --tx-2 text with no box, or remove them.

P1 'timelord on' toast (x322-441, y638-668): Move it to a top-centre banner under the 'extract 152m' pill, at y about 96. Use 20px --f-cond 700 text, a 3px --acc left bar, 16px padding, and fade it after 2s. Show the contract-item line the same way, and stop it sitting beside the hp bar.
