P1 'current pillagers 3' card (x8-367, y143-242): Use 16px --tx-2 for the header and the 'value at risk' label, and 20px --tx-1 for names. Set rows to 28px and padding to 16px. Mark 'you' with a 3px --acc bar. Right-align the $ values in tabular numerals and keep the chevron 16px from the edge.

P1 hp bar (x24-430, y1034-1068): Draw a 1px --ui-line-hi frame with a 4px radius on a --ui-panel track, with --ok as the fill. Set the label to 16px --f-cond 600 above the bar, with the value in 20px on the right. Keep a 5% margin from the screen edge.

goal-career-host-extracted.verdict: This is a clean, lower-case run-over card with a clear lime 0 sp hero and a single lime leaderboard button. It is held back by an empty score panel, text that is too small, and a weak lower half, so a player would call it decent but not polished. It is not the same screen as the earlier title-screen review, so I can't compare the two.
findings: P1 raid score panel (682-951, 219-522): Anchor the hero to the same baseline as the $5,065 total at y~485 and separate it with the same 1px divider. Or move the sp total to a full-width hero strip above both panels. Fill the gap with the 3 medal/bonus rows instead of leaving it blank.

P1 stat row labels and rows (698-1222, 240-440): Set all labels to 16px f-cond 600 in --tx-2 #aaa498 (4.5:1 or better), and set value rows to 20px. Use a 36px row pitch and keep the 'raid score' and 'money' headers at 16px with +.04em tracking.

P1 run goals row (985-1222, 427): Split it into two rows, 'run goals' and a sub-line of 'support mg' in 16px --tx-2 with a 24px indent. Or shorten it to 'support mg' and give the label column at least 16px of gap before the value.

P1 medals row (806-1114, 630-697): Enlarge each medal to 56px with a 2px --ui-line-hi border. Give each its own distinct glyph, or fill it with --acc-ink on --acc when earned. Replace the amber underline with a 16px tx-1 label. Make the gap between medals 24px.

P2 +130 xp and 'how did that run feel +' (889-1030, 740-808): Show '+130 xp' at 20px f-cond 700 in --tx-1, 24px below the medals. Make the survey a 16px --tx-2 text button with a 1px --ui-line border, 40px high, or remove it from the card. Pull the leaderboard button up so the gaps are 24px, 24px and 32px.

goal-career-host-hud.verdict: The clock, ammo and hotbar read well, but the top-right goals panel is still a dense wall of mixed small text, the left panel is tiny, and the duplicate extract markers, the explanatory feed line and the off-grid hp bar were not fixed.
findings: P1 top-right goals panel (1603-1900, 20-243): Use a 16px --tx-2 header row ('goals 0/3'). Use 20px --tx-1 rows with 8px gaps. Put a 1px --ui-line divider between 'contracts' and 'run goals'. Use 16px inner padding. Show progress right-aligned as 16px --acc only on the active row, and fix the 'item' tag to a 16px --warn glyph.

P1 left 'current pillagers' panel (8-367, 143-262): Set the rows to 20px f-cond 600 with the header at 16px --tx-2. Use 8px row gaps, 16px padding, --ui-panel at .9 fill and a 1px #4a5257 border. Move it to x=96 and share one chevron inset with the goals panel.

P1 extract pill (904-1016, 197-220) and right-edge marker 'c 152m' (1800-1890, 470-500): Keep only the pill, in 20px --extract. Put it 16px under the score card or move it next to the clock. Delete the right-edge text and keep only a teal arrow at the screen edge.
P1 left feed line (15-400, 775-805): Cut it to 'contract item nearby' at 20px --tx-1 on --ui-panel with a 3px --warn bar, x=96. Teach the glow once in how to play.

P1 hp bar (24-430, 1035-1068): Move it to x=96, bottom 54px. Make the bar 24px high with a #2e3337 track and an --ok fill. Put '100' at 32px f-cond 700 --tx-1 left of the bar, with 16px gaps to the chips.

goal-career-peer-extracted.verdict: This is now the real extracted card and it reads cleanly, with a clear lime CTA, a clear total and a teal title, but the two stat panels are uneven, the text is too small and dim, and the lower half drifts.
findings: P1 stat panels (x681-1239, y218-523): Make the two panels equal height with the content top-aligned, or merge the score into one row above the money panel. Make the one hero number the money total (56px, tx-1) and set the sp total to 32px. Use 16px tx-2 headers with +.04em tracking and a 1px --ui-line underline.

P1 money rows 'run goals' and 'run goals: support mg (field)' (y389-427): Rename the rows so each says what it is ('goal bonus', 'field goal'), make the signs consistent, and keep at least 16px between label and value. If the second row is a sub-line, indent it 16px in tx-2.

P1 lower half (y630-830): medals, '+130 xp', 'how did that run feel +': Use a 24px rhythm: medals, then '+130 xp' at 20px f-cond 600 in tx-1, then the survey as a 40px outlined secondary button at 20px with a --ui-line-hi border. Make the medal underlines --ui-line or the rarity colour as a 3px bar. Move the survey to the left of the CTA row.

P1 stat tiles (y539-613): Set the labels to tx-2 at 16px with +.04em tracking, values at 32px f-cond 700, and borders in --ui-line-hi. Align the tile row edges with the panel edges at x681 and x1239 (they already match, keep them).

P2 close x (x1246-1294, y157-204) vs title (y177): Make it a 40px square with a --ui-line-hi border and a tx-2 glyph, 16px from the card edge, with a lime border only on focus. Keep the title at 32px.

goal-demo-host-hud.verdict: The top-left list is gone, run info folds to a compact goals card and the hud reads cleaner, but the bottom-left stack and the top-centre cluster still ignore the shared panel, type and margin tokens.
findings: P1 top-centre cluster (845-1075, 18-340): clock, team score, extract chip, goal-done banner: Use one 16px gap between boxes and one --ui-panel fill with a 1px #4a5257 border and 4px radius. Make the clock the only hero at 56px f-cond 800. Set the goal-done banner title to 20px f-cond 700 and animate it away after 2s. Centre all boxes on x=960 with the same 280px width.

P1 hp and armour bars (24-430, 965-1068): Put both bars at 20px high on a --ui-panel plate with a 1px #4a5257 border and 4px radius. Set the text to 16px f-cond 700 --tx-1, and fill hp with --ok #76b97c. Keep the armour fill as one muted blue. Use an 8px gap between the bars. Leave the left margin at 54px and the bottom margin at 48px.

P1 status chips 'concealed' / 'in cover' (25-328, 912-950): Make both chips --tx-1 on --ui-panel with a 1px #4a5257 border, 16px f-cond 600, and a 4px radius. Keep the two icons at a 24px square with no ring. Use --acc, --warn or --danger only when a state is actually good, risky or bad.

P1 hotbar (553-1105, 955-1060): Draw every slot as a 72px tile with a --ui-panel fill, a 1px #4a5257 border and a 4px radius. Give the selected slot a 2px --acc #e6ff3d border. Set the numbers to 16px --tx-2 inside the tile at top-left. Drop empty icons to 30% opacity. Align the row bottom to the same 48px margin as hp.

P2 goals card (1603-1900, 18-138): Remove the 'run goals' line. Show each row as 'name' left and a --ok check or 'power-up' at the right, in a right-aligned 16px column. Use 16px padding, an 8px row gap and a 1px #4a5257 border. Match the 280px width of the centre cluster.

goal-demo-peer-hud.verdict: The HUD is much quieter than before: the controls list is folded to one line, the banner explainer is gone, and the old pillagers list and the 'run info' header are gone. It still looks like a stack of unrelated boxes, with a crowded top-centre, mixed type sizes and mixed corner radii.
findings: P1 top-centre stack (x845-1075, y18-338): Keep the 10:00 timer at 32px with the extract chip 8px below it. Move the team score to the top-left feed at x24/y24 at 16px. Show the goal-done toast only at y120 as the single alert, with a 16px gap below the chip. Give every box a 4px radius, a --ui-panel fill and a 1px --ui-line-hi border.

P1 goals panel (x1603-1900, y20-138): Delete the 'run goals' line and the repeated 'power-up' words. Use a 16px tx-2 header ('goals 1/3'), 16px rows in tx-1 and the done row in --ok with a check glyph. Use 16px padding, a 4px radius, a 1px --ui-line-hi border and x1872/y24 from the right and top edges (24px margin).

P1 bottom-left status cluster (x24-430, y910-1068): Make both bars 12px tall with a 16px label above each in tx-1. Keep the hp number at 20px, not 32px. Use equal-height pills with a 1px --warn or --extract border and tx-1 text. Put the 'f1 controls' chip at x24/y1000, directly above the hp bar, so it joins the cluster. Keep the 24px margin from the left and the bottom.

P1 ammo panel (x1668-1910, y902-1018): Right-align the panel to x1896 (24px margin) and align the bottom with the hp bar at y1056. Set 'burst carbine' at 16px tx-2. Keep the 56px f-cond 800 number, with '/ 144' at 20px in tx-2.

P2 weapon slots (x890-1105, y955-1060) and slot numbers (x560-1460, y960-975): Draw all 10 slots on one row of equal 48px tiles with an 8px gap and a --ui-panel fill, with empty ones at 40% opacity. Put the buff chip on a 16px f-cond 600 line, 8px above the row, with a --danger left bar of 3px. Use 'double damage' only at 16px.

30-hub-lift-kb.verdict: The hub does feel like this game, with a clear lime 'enter raid!' beacon. But the screen is crowded: overlapping translucent aura discs, two stacked prompts at the bottom, and a loud amber 'experimental' tag all compete for attention, and the capital letter in the [e] hint isn't the only break from the rules.
findings: P0 bottom centre, around the stash station and the 'enter raid!' prompt: Delete the welcome-pack sentence, or move it to the left feed. Show one prompt only, at 20px f-cond 600 on a --ui-panel pill with a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Place it 16px under the station label and clear the aura disc behind it. Use lime (--acc) text only when the prompt is the focused action.

P1 the whole floor: 8 aura discs of different tints, plus a large central disc: Remove the centre disc and keep one 1px ring per station at 12% opacity. Use one neutral tint, and lime only on the nearest station. Never overlap neighbours.

P1 enter raid! banner (top centre): Use a --ui-panel plate with a 4px radius and a 2px --acc border. Set the text at 32px f-cond 700 in --acc and drop the '!' so it matches the straight-copy rule. Align it centred 16px above the station, clear of the pillars.
P1 '***experimental feature may glitch***' tag under 'the last pour': Replace it with a 16px '--warn' glyph and one word ('beta') inside the station label chip, or drop it. Remove the asterisks.

P1 top-right currency strip: '$900 0 xp stash $5,064 bag $0': Use a vertical list on the right with a 16px label in --tx-2 and a 20px value in --tx-1, all items the same size. Put it in a --ui-panel box with 16px padding, 24px from the screen edge. Leave the build to cw-trcol if that job owns it.

30-hub-lift-pad.verdict: The hub reads as a prototype: the 'enter raid!' sign is the only strong accent but it clashes with the soft-rounded name tags, the bottom of the screen is a pile-up of tooltip, prompt, stash tag and hotbar, and nothing has a consistent type scale or panel style.
findings: P0 bottom centre: the stash tag, the 'welcome pack' tooltip, the '[a] enter raid!' prompt and the lift pad: Keep one prompt pill at 20px f-cond, --acc fill with --acc-ink text, 8px above the pad. Delete the welcome-pack sentence (or move it to a 16px label on the stash tag only). Drop the duplicate prompt, since the top sign already names the action.
P0 top-right 'the mainframe' zone: Remove the stray circle or snap it to the zone centre. Use one halo style: 2px --ui-line-hi ring at 12% fill, with only the active zone in --acc or its own colour.
P1 'enter raid!' sign, top centre: Make it a 32px f-cond 700 label in a --ui-panel box with a 1px --acc border, 4px radius, and remove the '!'. Reserve a filled lime fill for the live prompt only.

P1 name tags (gambler, mainframe, shop, settings, the last pour, fashion, the stash): One tag spec: 16px f-cond 600, 8px 12px padding, --ui-panel fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius, centred 12px above the station. Offset 'the stash' and 'fashion' to avoid avatars.
P1 '***experimental feature may glitch***' under 'the last pour': Replace with a small 14px --warn glyph plus the word 'beta' inside the station tag, or drop it. Remove the asterisks.

30-hub-midroom-kb.verdict: The hub is readable and the lime 'enter raid!' call-out is the right first read, but it is let down by a crowded middle, overlapping glow circles, mixed label styles and an untidy top-right readout.
findings: P1 station labels (gambler, mainframe, shop craft and hire, settings, last pour, stash, fashion): Light only the nearest station: 2px --acc border and --tx-1 text, with the others dimmed to --tx-2 at 70% opacity. Anchor every label 8px above its pad. Use the same 20px f-cond 600 for all labels, with 8px/16px padding and a 4px radius.

P1 top-right readout: '$900  0 xp  stash $5,064 bag $0': Make every item 20px f-cond 600 in one panel (--ui-panel, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius, 16px padding). Stack them vertically with 8px gaps. Use --tx-1 for values and --tx-2 for labels, and keep the right margin at least 32px.

P1 '***experimental feature may glitch***' under 'the last pour': Drop the asterisks and shorten it to 'experimental'. Set it at 16px --warn inside the label pill as a small tag. Alternatively, drop the text and use a 16px warn glyph beside the title.

P1 hub floor: translucent glow circles and rings: Remove stray and overlapping circles. Keep one 1px --ui-line-hi ring per station, with the nearest station's ring in --acc at 40% fill. Keep each pad's colour only if it is a tied-down meaning, and cap the circle fill at 8% opacity.

P2 bottom toast 'the welcome pack is in your stash.' and the hotbar: Move the toast to the top-centre banner slot, or the left feed, and trim it to 'welcome pack in stash'. Raise the empty-slot icons to 50% opacity. Change the selected slot border to --acc 2px. Keep the hotbar at least 24px from the toast.

30-hub-midroom-pad.verdict: the hub reads as a busy template: a huge lime 'enter raid!' sign is the only strong hierarchy, while a noisy room of overlapping glow circles and a clipped, mixed-style HUD make it look unfinished.
findings: P0 top-right currency strip ($900, 0 xp, stash $5,064 bag $0): Make it one vertical list in the top-right with a 48px margin: $900, xp and stash each as a 20px f-cond 600 row, tx-1 for the value and tx-2 for the 16px label. Remove the 'xp' sub-label size jump and put 'bag' on its own row.

P0 station label 'enter raid!' (top centre): Make it the same 20px tag as the other stations, lime text only when focused or in range, no '!' ('enter raid'). If it must be the hero, give it the 32px title size and keep the same dark tag fill with a 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius.

P1 proximity glow circles around each station and the player: Remove the fills and show one 2px ring in --acc at 60% only on the station the player is currently in range of; the other stations show a 1px --ui-line ring or none.
P1 '***experimental feature may glitch***' under 'the last pour': Replace with a small --warn glyph or the single word 'beta' at 16px inside the same tag as the station label; delete the asterisks.

P1 toast 'the welcome pack is in your stash.' and 'the stash' tag: Show it in the left feed only (one place for a line), 16px, or drop it. If it stays, place it in the bottom-left above the hotbar, never on a station.

r9-hub-p1.verdict: This is the in-world hub, not the title menu I reviewed before. The lime 'enter raid!' sign is a strong hero, but the amber 'pillager' tag, the asterisk warning, the toast and the tiny top-right readouts all compete with it and collide with other labels.
findings: P1 'pillager' name tag over the fashion station (bottom left): Set the tag to 16px f-cond 600 tx-1 on a 4px-radius --ui-panel chip. Float it 8px above the head and shift it away from station labels. Amber is for the P1 ring only.

P1 top-right readouts: '$900 0 xp' and 'stash $365 bag $0': Build one 1 by 1 list on a --ui-panel card at 96px from the right edge. Use 20px tx-1 values with 16px tx-2 labels, all the same size. Show $900 as the single 20px value, keep stash and bag on a 16px tx-2 line, and use the 'xp' unit only if it is a real stat.

P1 '***experimental feature may glitch***' under 'the last pour': Delete the sentence and the asterisks. Put a 16px '--warn' 'beta' tag inside the 'the last pour' chip, or show the warning only when the player approaches.

P2 hotbar, bottom centre: Use one focus style: a --ui-raised fill with a 3px lime bottom bar for the selected slot only. Drop empty and unavailable slots to 40% opacity with no border. Make the number labels 16px tx-2. Move the bar to 24px from the bottom edge.

P2 'pillager joined' toast and 'keyboard' chip: Give every notice one chip style: --ui-panel fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius, 16px tx-1. Put the toast in the left feed. Show the 'keyboard' chip as a 16px tx-2 hint, not a green box, or remove it.

r9-hub-p2.verdict: This is a different screen from the earlier title column (it's the in-world hub with a hotbar). It reads as a crowded prototype: the lime 'enter raid!' sign shouts over everything, there are three unrelated label styles, a debug-looking warning, and the rim/HUD margins are unaligned.
findings: P0 '***experimental feature may glitch***' under 'the last pour': Delete the sentence. If a flag is needed, show a 16px '--warn' #f5b73b word 'beta' with no asterisks, set inside the tag as a small chip. The tag keeps the same 4px radius and fill as its neighbours.

P1 'enter raid!' sign, top-centre: Use a 'enter raid' label (no '!') in f-cond 800 at 40px, --acc-ink on a flat --acc fill, 56px high, 4px radius, 24px side padding. Keep the lime fill and drop the glow and shadow. Show the pad/key prompt next to it at 16px. Move it clear of the pillar, centred on the portal.

P1 All station tags: 'wirt the gambler', 'the mainframe', 'shop, craft, and hire', 'settings', 'the stash', 'fashion', 'the last pour', 'in pillager's party': One tag spec: --ui-panel #16191b fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius, 20px f-cond 600 in --tx-1, 8px/16px padding. Centre each tag 24px above its pad. Drop the circle fills to 8% opacity, or use only the 2px ring. Fix the double circle on the mainframe.

P1 Top-right HUD: '$900', '0 xp', 'stash $365 bag $0': Put these in one 1×1 list as the cw-trcol job does: every row 20px f-cond 600, labels at 16px in --tx-2, values in --tx-1, 48px from the right and top. Use '$' for money only. Remove the 'xp' size change.

P1 Hotbar, bottom centre: One state only: selected gets a 2px --acc border and a --ui-raised fill. All the rest get a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Draw the numerals at 16px in --tx-2 and the empty icons at 40% opacity or more. Keep a 8px gap and the same slot size of 90px.

r9-raid-p1.verdict: The raid HUD is clean and readable, with a good hero ammo number. But it repeats the extract distance, stacks small chips unevenly along the bottom, and doesn't follow the one-place-per-line rule or the single-accent rule.
findings: P1 Top-centre 'extract 152m' chip and right-edge 'c 152m' marker: Keep the top-centre banner and drop the edge text, or keep only the arrow with no text. If an edge marker stays, spell it 'extract' and set it at 16px with the teal --extract colour.

P1 Bottom-left status row (concealed, in cover, f1 controls) and the hp bar: Put both status chips on one 40px-high row aligned to the 96px margin, with the same --ui-panel fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius. Make 'concealed' warn amber and 'in cover' extract teal, both as small glyph-plus-word at 16px. Place 'f1 controls' on the same baseline as a 16px --tx-2 key hint. Set the hp number at 20px f-cond 700 inside a 32px bar with 8px padding.

P1 Hotbar (slots 1-8 and 9/0): Draw every slot as a 64×64 --ui-panel tile with a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Mark the selected slot with a 3px --acc bar and a --ui-raised fill. Put the slot numbers at 16px in --tx-2 (#aaa498). Close the gap by grouping 1-8 and 9-0 with an even 8px spacing and a single 24px divider.
P2 Top-right 'run Info' dropdown: Render it as 'run info' in lower case. Use a 40px-high --ui-panel bar with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 16px label, and keep it collapsed to roughly 160px wide.

P2 Top-left 'current pillagers 3' panel and the 'pillager' bar below it: Add 8px of row padding and 1px --ui-line dividers. Make the header 16px --tx-2 and the rows 16px --tx-1, with the values right-aligned in tabular numerals. Leave a 24px gap before the 'pillager' bar, and use the same bar style and green as the bottom hp bar.

r9-raid-p2.verdict: The overlapping bandage card is gone, but the HUD is still a pile of mismatched chips and panels, with a capital I in 'run info', a full-bleed hp bar, and tiny text.
findings: P1 top-right 'run info' dropdown: Render it as 'run info' with no capitals. Make it one chip: --ui-panel at 90%, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius, 16px f-cond 600, 8px/16px padding. Hug the text and push the chevron to the right padding. Sit it 32px from the top and right screen edges.

P1 bottom-left hp bar: Put it in a --ui-panel plate with a 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius and a 32px inset from the bottom and left edges. Make the label 20px f-cond 700, and the fill 16px tall in --ok. Keep the 56px hero size for ammo.

P1 top-left 'current pillagers' panel and 'pillager' plate: Set all text to 16px, with 32px rows. Give the 'you' row a 3px --acc bar and tx-1. Set values in tabular f-cond tx-2 and the header in tx-2 at 16px. Use one --ui-panel fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius and 16px padding. Move the caret to 16px from the right. Dock the 'pillager' hp plate to the panel, or move it to the hp corner.

P1 bottom centre 'in pillager's party' tag and 'f1 controls' chip: Use one chip style for every tag. Put the party tag in the left feed, or at top-centre under the extract chip. Set 'f1 controls' at 16px with a 1px --ui-line-hi key chip, mid-bottom-left at 32px from the edge, 24px clear of slot 1.

P1 hotbar, slots 1-8 with 9 and 0: Draw all 10 slots at 72px square with 8px gaps, each in --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line. Numerals 16px tx-2. Keep slot 1 selected with a 3px --acc border. Centre the whole row on the screen and align its bottom with the ammo card at 32px from the edge.

r9-stash-p1.verdict: This is a competent dark stash window with a clear lime 'take' action, but it is crowded: the tab row carries too many controls, the keys pane is a dense grid of small tiles, and about two thirds of the stash pane is empty. The previous review was of a different screen (the title screen), so this is a fresh read.
findings: P1 Left stash pane, below the 4 items: Draw the full grid of empty slots (for example 6 columns by 5 rows of 152px tiles with a 1px --ui-line border at 40% opacity) so capacity reads like the Diablo IV inventory. Or add a 20px tx-2 'nothing else stashed' line, centred in the pane.

P1 Tab row (all, guns, consumables, parts, salvage, keycards, valuables, locked, search, sort, armory, trophies): Dim the zero-count tabs to tx-2 at 60% opacity, or hide them. Move 'armory 3/16' and 'trophies 0/8' to the header row, or draw them as outlined 40px-tall buttons. Shrink the search field to a 240px icon field, and keep 'sort' as a quiet 16px dropdown.

P1 Keys pane: gun keys and item wheel tiles: Make the tiles 128×88 with 32px icons. Place the key number in a 20×20 chip at the top-left with 8px padding. Drop empty tiles to 40% opacity with a dashed border. Give the item wheel a 24px gap from the gun keys and make the wheel tile a circle or a centre marker.

P2 Header row, right side ($900, 0 xp, stash $365 bag $0): Keep $900 at 32px tx-1 as the only large number. Set '0 xp' and the stash/bag value at 16px tx-2, with 24px between them. Remove the duplicate '$365 going up' or the header copy. Align the group's baseline to the 'stash' title.

P2 Footer key legend (drag, right click, shift, ctrl, alt, 1-9,0): Set the legend text to 16px at #aaa498 or brighter with +.04em tracking, not +.15em. Add 16px of padding between the legend and the 'freebie kit' row. Put a 1px --ui-line divider between them.

rarity-stash.verdict: The window is clean, dark and consistent. The earlier P1 problems are still there: the stash grid leaves a large dead area, the header money is split into three small pieces, and the controls row is crowded.
findings: P1 stash grid and lower left pane (x 110-1085, y 530-890): Dock a 320px detail pane in the empty area below the grid, with name, rarity bar and stats for the focused tile. Remove the floating tooltip for pad and keyboard focus. Keep the 2px --acc outline on the focused tile.

P1 right pane below the hotbar (x 1087-1810, y 590-890): Enlarge the backpack slots to fill the pane height, or add a loadout summary below the hotbar. Use solid 1px --ui-line borders in place of dashes.

P1 header money row (x 1430-1745, y 80-105): Show '$48,250' alone at 32px f-cond 700 --tx-1. Put 'stash $17,654 · bag $0' on one 16px --tx-2 line beneath it, and move 'xp' into that line. Right-align it with a 24px gap left of the X.

P1 tab and filter row (y 125-170): Set tabs to 20px --fs-body and add a 3px --acc underline on the active tab. Move sort, armory and trophies into a separate right-aligned group at least 24px from the search box, or into the footer. Shorten the search box to 280px.

P2 stash and backpack sub-headers (y 185-225): Remove the second 'backpack' label and fold the count into the tab as 'backpack 0/12'. Use one style for all counters: 16px --tx-2. Hide '$0 going up' when it is zero.

rarity-gamble.verdict: The gamble window is tidy and uses the style tokens correctly, but the lower third of the card is empty, the gamble panel has a hole in it, and the small type is under the guide's 16px floor.
findings: P1 card bottom, y 700-1020: Stretch both panels to the card's bottom padding (bottom edge near y 1000). Or shrink the card to fit its content. Or center the panels vertically in the body. Give the body 24px padding on every side.

P1 the gamble panel, y 430-585: Enlarge the question-mark tile to about 280px, centered like the offer art, with the odds list below it at 20px row height. This mirrors the right panel's layout. Alternatively, pin the button to the bottom and spread the content evenly.
P1 odds labels and percentages, header stats: Raise the labels, percentages and stats to 16px with +.04em tracking, in tx-1 or tx-2. Make the bars 8px tall. Use a row pitch of 36px.

P2 header money row, top right: Use one style for all three stats: 20px label, with only the money value in tx-1 600. Space them 32px apart. Leave a 24px gap before the X. Do not use a bold white number for xp.

P2 offer panel body: Cut the 'new limited time offer arrives...' line to a short timer such as '3:00' (label size, beside the panel title). Keep one line, 'worth $14,904', in tx-2 at 16px. Give the art tile a 1px line-hi border.

p1-alert.verdict: The HUD is readable and mostly follows the lower-case, one-accent rules, but the missed-extraction alert is a small amber banner with no urgency. The top-centre status cluster has no clear order, and the leaderboard and run-info panels compete with it.
findings: P1 top-centre alert 'extraction missed': Make it a 56px f-cond 800 banner (hero tier) on --ui-panel with a 4px --danger left bar and a --danger icon. Use the bounce-in motion (--m-in 240ms) and hold it for 3s. Add a short second line in 20px tx-2, such as 'next extraction in 2:10', so the player has something to do.

P1 top-centre cluster (3:20 timer, 'extract 30m' pill, alert): Put the timer and the pill in one --ui-panel plate, 8px padding, 4px radius, centred on x=960. Put the alert directly under it with a 16px gap, on the same centre axis. Give the timer a solid plate so it is no longer bare text over the walls.

P1 left leaderboard 'current pillagers 0': Raise the rows to 16px and make the 'you' row 20px tx-1 with a 3px --acc left bar. Drop the dead rows to a single '7 dead' summary line, or fold them with a chevron. Remove the magenta unless it is the P2 cyan or an agreed player colour. Make the dead rows tx-2 and the dollar amounts tabular and right-aligned.

P1 'extraction a available' and 'elite cache' world tags: Use one tag style: --ui-panel fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius, 16px f-cond 600, 8px/4px padding. Keep teal only for the extraction tag's glyph or border. Hide 'extraction a available' while the missed alert is showing, or change it to 'extraction a: closed'.

P2 top-right minimap and 'run info' dropdown: Frame the minimap with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Set the 'run info' bar to the same 4px radius, an 8px gap and a 20px label. Align the right edge to the 5% margin (96px) used elsewhere, as the leaderboard does on the left.

p1-feed.verdict: The raid HUD has the right pieces, but the 'extraction missed' state is weak: the event is a small left-edge toast far from the action, while the large leaderboard and the stray 'extraction available' tag compete with it.
findings: P0 'extraction missed' toast, bottom-left (x≈15-197, y≈777-802): Put 'extraction missed' in the top-centre alert banner at --fs-title 32px with a --danger or --warn accent bar. Remove the left-edge copy. If a feed line remains, set the left inset to at least 48px.

P0 'extraction a available' tag over the extraction ring (x≈570-725, y≈460-480): Fix the text, for example 'extraction open'. Hide or switch the tag to a 'closed' state once the extraction is missed. Use 20px --f-cond on --ui-panel with --tx-1 text and a 3px --extract bar.

P1 Leaderboard panel, top-left (x≈8-367, y≈143-333): Collapse to the top 3 rows plus 'you' by default. Set rows to 16px --f-cond with 24px line height and --tx-2 at 4.5:1 or better. Mark dead rows with a --danger dot instead of text. Drop the purple, or tie it to rarity or party colour and explain it. Use an opaque --ui-panel fill with a 1px --ui-line-hi border.

P1 Top-right minimap and 'run info' dropdown (x≈1603-1900, y≈18-362): Give the minimap a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius on a --ui-panel plate. Sit 'run info' flush under it with the same width, a 16px gap and the same 4px radius. Enlarge or remove the compass 'n'. Keep a 48px margin from the screen edge.

P1 Top-centre clock and 'extract 30m' (x≈895-1030, y≈10-75): Show the timer at --fs-hero 56px f-cond 800 on a --ui-panel plate. Replace 'extract 30m' with one clear line, for example 'extract in 30:00'. Move the direction arrow onto the screen edge or the minimap.

p2-alert.verdict: The missed-extraction banner is clear and sits in the right place, but the HUD around it is crowded, uses mixed type sizes and has a few text errors.
findings: P1 extraction missed banner (top centre) and the 'extract 30m' pill plus clock above it: Remove or grey the 'extract 30m' pill while the missed state is showing. Make the banner 56px tall with a 4px left bar and no underline. Use tx-1 for the text with the amber only on the glyph. Keep the banner at least 160px from the clock.

P1 'extraction a available' label (left centre, teal): Fix the string, or hide the label and ring when the extraction is missed. If extraction really is still available, change the banner wording so the two do not contradict each other.

P1 scoreboard panel at top left ('current pillagers 0', 'value at risk'): Show only the top 3–4 rows plus 'you'. Drop the footer line. Set every row to 16px in tx-2, with 'you' in tx-1. Put the purple row in the P2 cyan or in tx-1. Use the --ui-panel fill at 85% opacity with a 1px --ui-line-hi border.

P2 bottom-left 'hp 100' bar and the '4 minutes left' tag: Make the hp label 20px inside the bar and let the bar be 24px tall with a 4px radius. Move the timer into the top-centre cluster next to the clock, or drop it. Keep one hero number per screen: the ammo.
P2 hotbar (bottom centre): Draw empty slots as 1px --ui-line tiles of the same size, or hide them. Change the selected border to --acc at 3px. Use a 96px grid with 8px gaps.

p2-feed.verdict: The HUD is readable and mostly lower case, but it shows contradictory extraction messages, scatters small low-contrast text around the screen, and shows a tiny, easy-to-miss missed-extraction notice.
findings: P0 extraction state: world label 'extraction a available' (648,470), left feed 'extraction missed' (105,789), top banner 'extract 30m': Remove the 'extraction a available' label once extraction is missed, or change it to 'closed'. Fix the typo. Send the miss to the top-centre alert banner at --fs-title 32px in --danger, and keep the left feed to one short line. Make the banner and the ring state agree.

P1 left feed 'extraction missed' (15-198, 778-802): Use --danger for the miss, set the text at 20px, and put it on a --ui-panel fill (80% opacity) with a 3px bar. Use the same 24px padding as the other feed rows and give it a 160ms bounce-in.

P1 top-left 'current pillagers' panel (10-367, 143-333): Show only the top 3 plus 'you', or fold the list into 'run info'. Use 16px minimum text, make the 'you' row --acc or --ui-raised with a 3px bar, and show 'dead' as --danger glyphs, not words. Set the header at 16px in --tx-2 and the 'you' value at 20px in --tx-1. Give every row a 32px height.

P1 HUD type sizes overall: 'f1 controls' (440-540, 942), 'run info', 'b / i backpack' (1684, 1027), slot numbers 3,5-0 (~14px): Set all labels to at least 16px in --tx-2 on a --ui-panel plate. Remove or dim the empty slot numbers, or fold them into slot frames. Move 'f1 controls' to sit left-aligned with the hp bar, in one short line on a plate.

P2 bottom-centre hotbar (558-948, 968-1055): Draw all 10 slots at 72px with a 4px radius and a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Mark the selected slot with a --acc 3px border. Use a consistent 8px gap and put the numbers at one fixed offset.

35-p1-under-gun.verdict: The HUD has the same problems as the last review: the top-centre stack is crowded, the goals panel is dense, and the ammo is faded, so it still reads as a prototype overlay.
findings: P0 top-centre stack: timer 5:33, score card, 'extract 157m · closing' chip, 'extraction a closing' banner: Delete the chip. Change the banner to 'extraction closing' with 'closes in 1:33' at 16px. Make the timer the only 56px hero and put the score under it as a 20px inline line with no card. Use one --ui-panel style (1px --ui-line-hi, 4px radius) and 8px gaps.

P0 goals panel (right, y 328-552) and minimap: Add 12px inner padding and 8px row spacing. Set the section labels to 16px tx-2 and the rows to 20px tx-1, with counts right-aligned. Put a 1px --ui-line divider between sections. Show 3 rows or fold the panel to the single line 'goals 0/3'. Fix or remove 'the seal 0%'. Shrink the minimap to 240-280px and use a --ui-panel fill at 92% opacity.

P1 bottom-right ammo block 'compact smg 30 / 60' and 'air strike' bar: Draw '30' at 56px f-cond 800 in tx-1 and '/ 60' at 20px in tx-2, on an opaque --ui-panel fill. Set the gun name to 20px tx-2. Remove the backpack hint or raise it to 16px. Style the air strike bar like the other bars, with an --acc fill, and leave a 16px gap above the ammo.

P1 top-left 'current pillagers 0' dropdown: Make it a --ui-panel block with 12px padding and a 4px radius. Show the labels in tx-2 and the values in tx-1 at 20px, for example '7 dead · 0 out' with '$1,770' right-aligned. Align it to the 96px margin.

P1 hotbar and hp bar, bottom: Hide empty slots 5-0, or draw them as 1px --ui-line outlines at 56px. Make the active slot's border the only lime element. Move the hp bar to x=96 and make it a --ui-panel bar with an --ok fill and 20px --acc-ink text. Align the hp baseline with the hotbar bottom.

35-p1-under-minimap.verdict: The minimap is now a transparent window with no border, and it butts against the goals panel. Extraction is still shown three times, the stray 'a' typos are still there, and the top-centre stack still has no clear hierarchy.
findings: P0 top-centre: 'extract 157m · closing' pill, 'extraction a closing' card, and bottom-left 'extraction a available' tag: Keep only the top-centre card, in --extract teal, reading 'extraction closes in 1:33 · 157m'. Delete the pill and the bottom-left tag. Fix the strings to 'extraction closing' and 'extraction open'.

P0 minimap (x1603-1900, y20-318) and goals panel (y328-552): Give the minimap fill --ui-panel at 90% opacity and a 1px --ui-line-hi border with a 4px radius. Inset the icons 8px. Keep a 16px gap above the goals panel, on the same right margin as that panel.

P1 timer 5:33, score panel and sun icon (top centre): Merge them into one 240px panel. Make the 5:33 timer 56px weight 800 as the hero, and put 'score 9,100 sp' at 20px tx-1 beneath it. Put the sun inside the panel, left-aligned. Leave 16px to the extraction card.

P1 goals panel (x1603-1900): Make the 'goals 0/3' header 20px tx-1. Make the section labels 16px tx-2 with +.04em tracking. Make the rows 16px tx-1 with 8px gaps and 16px left padding. Remove the '6pm clear' line. Collapse 'run goals' by default.

P1 top-left 'current pillagers 0' bar (x8-367, y142-170): Make it a 4px-radius --ui-panel card with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and an 8px inset. Use the 16px label 'pillagers 0'. Shrink it to about 200px wide and align it to the 48px margin.

35-p1-under-score.verdict: The minimap is smaller, which helps, but the score and timer are still faded under props and now read as ghosted grey boxes. The goals panel is still fully open and crowded. The extraction banner still has a typo and a duplicate pill, so it is a busy HUD with no clear first read.
findings: P0 top-centre score and timer (5:33, 9,100 sp): Merge them into one 4px-radius --ui-panel plate at 85% opacity, about 240x96, centred at y=16. Keep the text at full --tx-1 and never fade it below 100%. Fade only the plate fill, and no lower than 70%. Make the score 32px weight 700, the timer 20px, and the 'score' label 16px --tx-2.

P0 extraction banner 'extraction a closing': Fix the copy to 'extraction closing'. Delete the 'extract 157m · closing' pill and put the distance in line 2: 'closes in 1:33 · 157m' at 16px --tx-2. Use --extract teal for the icon and left bar, not amber, and give the banner a 4px radius and a 4px left bar. Drop the title to 20px weight 700.

P1 goals panel, right-middle (1603,328 to 1901,552): Fold it to one line 'goals 0/3' by default and open it with a key. If it stays open: headings at 16px --tx-2 +.04em, rows at 20px --tx-1, 8px between groups, a 1px --ui-line divider between groups, a maximum of 4 rows, and a 16px gap below the minimap.

P1 top-left 'current pillagers 0' dropdown: Fold it to a 16px chip about 160px wide ('pillagers 0'). Add an 'at risk' row below it: $1,770 at 20px weight 700 --tx-1 with the 'at risk' label at 16px --tx-2. Make the chevron --tx-2 and 16px.

P1 minimap and goals panels, top-right: Use a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius on both panels, with the same width of 300px. Dim the wall bars to --ui-line-hi. Draw the player marker at 12px in --acc. Pad the chevrons 8px from the edge.

35-p2-under-gun.verdict: The panels are now capped and anchored top-right, but the HUD is still crowded and inconsistent: the contract toast is clipped by hotbar slot 1, the top-centre stack repeats itself, and the bottom-right panels sit against each other with no gap.
findings: P0 bottom-left: 'contract item nearby · gold glow m…' toast: Cap the toast at 340px with ellipsis, or shorten it to 'contract item nearby'. Move it to y~640 above the hotbar. Leave a 16px gap to the f1 chip and a 16px gap to slot 1.

P0 bottom-right: air strike bar, ammo block, backpack hint: Use one right-hand column of 360px with a 24px right inset, matching the minimap and goals panel. Give both the air strike bar and the ammo block an opaque --ui-panel fill, a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Put 16px between the two panels. Set the weapon name in tx-1 at 20px and the 56px 30 in --acc or tx-1.

P1 top-centre: timer, score, extract pill, extraction-closing banner: Remove the pill and fold '157m' into the banner subline ('157m · closes in 1:33'). Make the timer and score one 360px panel. Give the banner a 3px --warn left bar only and no full outline. Leave 16px between the score block and the banner.

P1 goals panel text (top right): Set the section labels at 16px f-cond 600 tx-2 with .04em tracking and the items at 20px tx-1. Add a 1px --ui-line divider between groups and 8px row padding. Use an opaque --ui-panel fill. Align the chevron with the minimap's at 16px from the right edge.

P1 top-left: 'current pillagers 0' dropdown: Remove it from the raid HUD, or restyle it as a --ui-panel pill at 24px from the left and top. Fold the 'keyboard' badge into the same pill at 16px f-cond.

35-p2-under-minimap.verdict: The HUD is still crowded and inconsistent: the goals panel is still a long list of text, the top-centre stack is stacked three deep, and the left feed text is clipped by the weapon bar.
findings: P0 left feed 'contract item nearby · gold glow m' (18-375 x 715-748): Cap feed width at 340px and ellipsize or wrap it. Move the feed up to y≈640 so it clears the slot bar by 16px. Put 'f1 controls' at the bottom-left as a 16px line, 32px from the edge.

P0 top-centre stack (876-1140 x 20-385): Delete the chip. Fix the banner text to 'extraction closing'. Give the timer the hero 56px and drop the score to a 20px line under it with no card. Use --warn only on the banner's 3px left bar.

P1 goals panel (1540-1898 x 395-663): Default to a collapsed 3 rows (header 'goals 0/3' plus the next goal). Headers in --tx-2 16px, rows in --tx-1 20px, 16px gaps between sections. Inset 48px from the right edge and 16px from the minimap. Fill: opaque --ui-panel.

P1 weapon bar (375-1465 x 690-800): Draw all 10 slots as 72px tiles with an 8px gap and a 1px --ui-line border. The selected tile gets a 2px --acc border, not amber. Numbers at 16px, inside the top-left corner of the tile. Dim empty tiles to 40%.

P1 bottom-right stack: air strike bar and ammo card (1535-1910 x 803-1047): Align both to a 320px column inset 48px from the right and bottom. Raise the air strike text to 16px, with the fill in --acc, or --warn when cooling down. Keep '30' at 56px and make '/ 60' 20px in --tx-2. Use the same 4px radius and 1px --ui-line-hi border as the other panels.

35-p2-under-score.verdict: The score and clock panels are now deliberately faded and the sprite shows through them, so the hero number is unreadable. The banner still has its duplicate pill and the 'extraction a closing' typo, and the goals panel is an unstructured text dump.
findings: P0 top-centre clock (5:33) and score (9,160 sp) panels: Fade the panel fill only and keep the text at 100% opacity, with a floor of 70% panel opacity. Alternatively, fade only while the player is within 120px, and keep the text at tx-1 32px f-cond 700. Draw the sprite below the HUD layer. Add 16px padding and put the 'score' label at 16px tx-2 on its own line above the number.

P0 banner stack under the score: Delete the pill. Keep one card that reads 'extraction closing' with '1:33' at 56px f-cond 800 in --extract teal, and drop the 'closes in' line. Show the 157m distance as a 16px tx-2 suffix. Remove or relabel the 5:33 clock so there is only one timer.

P1 goals panel, right, y 395-690: Use 16px tx-2 section labels with +.04em tracking and 20px f-cond 600 item rows. Put the counts right-aligned in lime or tx-2. Fix the wrap with a hanging indent of 16px. Use 16px padding and an 8px gap below the minimap. Show only the active 3 goals and collapse the rest behind the chevron.

P1 minimap, top-right: Reduce it to about 300px and dim the fill to --ui-void at 85%. Use a 1px --ui-line-hi border with a 4px radius. Move the 'n' to 8px inside the corner. Make the markers at least 16px.

P1 bottom-right ammo and air strike stack: Make both 340px wide with a shared 5% right margin and a 16px gap. Set labels at 16px tx-2. Give the 'b / i backpack' hint 16px of padding from the bottom edge. Remove the ghost sprite or lower it to 10% opacity.

status-type-solo.verdict: the hud has the right ingredients (clock, extract chip, hp bar, weapon card) but the text is soft and cramped, the type sizes and panels disagree with each other, and the lime accent barely appears.
findings: P0 top-left 'current pillagers' list: set rows to 32px with 16px f-cond 600 text. Put the name left and the value right in tx-1, with a tx-2 header at 16px. Give the panel 16px padding and a 1px --ui-line divider. Use amber for the P1 'you' row and cyan for P2. Keep the list to 4 rows.

P0 all hud text, especially 'hp 100', the buff names and the ammo '8 / 24': render at native resolution with f-cond. Set buff names to 20px tx-1 and the sub-lines to 16px tx-2 (#aaa498). Put hp in --ui-panel with a 4px green bar and a 20px tx-1 number outside the fill, or use --acc-ink on the green fill.

P1 hierarchy: ammo card, hp bar, clock: make the hp bar 12px tall and 320px wide, with the fill in --ok at 70% saturation. Make the ammo hero number 56px --tx-1 with a lime --acc underline or reserve bar. Give the clock a 32px title size, and make the icon tx-2 unless it is a real alert.

P1 buff stack, left side (stim, active reload, steady hand, beast mode, liquor): make every row a fixed 200x48 panel on a 16px left margin. Use a 32px icon in a --ui-line-hi ring, a 20px name and a 16px tx-2 timer right-aligned. Move the buff name and its '+15% damage' into one consistent pattern. Use one icon tint, with --warn for debuffs only.

P1 top-right 'run info' dropdown and 'the long dock cache' label: inset top-right to a 5% margin (96px at 1080 width) and use the same panel, 16px padding and 20px label as the player list. Anchor the cache tag to its world marker with a 4px line, or move it to the left feed. Align the two top panels on one baseline.

status-type-solo-full-legend.verdict: The full controls legend is a washed-out, near-unreadable wall of tiny text over the map, and the status stack beside it has cramped, overlapping text and an inconsistent type scale.
findings: P0 controls legend panel, left side x10-375 y165-815: Raise the text to at least 16px at 1080 in --tx-2 #aaa498, or --tx-1 for keys. Put it on an opaque --ui-panel #16191b at 92% with a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Group the rows into 3 or 4 short blocks with a 16px header each, drop the full-height panel to about 360px wide, and trim the descriptions to 2-3 words.

P1 legend section headers (move, fight, gear, world, team, also): Make the headers 16px f-cond 700 in --tx-1 with 24px space above each, and keep lime for focus only. Add 1px --ui-line dividers between groups.

P1 buff stack (stim, active reload x3, steady hand, beast mode, liquor), x560-760 y430-700: Use a fixed 200px pill width, 56px row height and 8px gap. Set the title to 20px --tx-1 and the sub-label to 16px --tx-2, and fix the liquor clipping. Move the stack to the left feed or the bottom-left edge, away from the player.

P1 ammo and weapon block, bottom right x1703-1908 y922-1048: Add 16px padding inside the box, set the name to 16px --tx-2 with a 24px line height, and right-align it with the number. Raise the hint to 16px with a 4.5:1 contrast ratio, or drop it.

P1 hotbar, bottom centre x548-1500 y968-1060: Draw all 10 slots as 56px tiles with --ui-panel fill and a 1px --ui-line border, with the number at 16px in the top-left. Mark the selected slot with a --acc 2px border instead of amber.
